stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

title.en: Caregiver role strain in home management of moderate Alzheimer's dementia
title.zh: 中度阿尔茨海默病居家照护中的照护者角色压力

summary.en: Margaret Tierney is a 78-year-old woman with moderate Alzheimer's dementia who lives with her daughter Diane, her sole caregiver. Diane requested home-health support after two months of worsening nighttime wandering and confusion, stating she cannot continue alone. The case unfolds across an initial home visit, later same-visit disclosures, and a five-day follow-up.
summary.zh: Margaret Tierney，78岁，中度阿尔茨海默病，与女儿 Diane 同住；Diane 是唯一照护者。因过去两个月夜间走失和意识混乱加重，Diane 请求居家护理支持，并表示自己无法再独自承担。病例按初次居家访视、同次访视后续透露信息和5天后复诊逐步展开。

title.zh: 初次居家护理访视记录

content.en:
Background: Margaret has a 3-year history of Alzheimer's dementia and is followed by a memory-care clinic. Medical history includes hypertension treated with amlodipine 5 mg daily and lisinopril 10 mg daily, osteoarthritis of both knees, and remote left hip fracture repair 5 years ago. She has not been seen by the memory-care clinic in 9 months because Diane could not get time off work.

Initial presentation at 10:00 AM Tuesday: Diane appears fatigued with dark circles, took a half-day off work, and must leave by noon. A neighbor will stay with Margaret from noon until Diane returns from work, but this is an informal favor. Diane reports Margaret was up 4 times last night and tried to go outside at 2 AM. Diane has been placing a chair against Margaret's bedroom door at night because she cannot stay awake. Diane has slept less than 4 consecutive hours for weeks, lost 12 lb in 2 months, called in sick to work 3 times last month, and says she promised her father she would never place Margaret in a home.

Margaret is seated in a recliner wearing a urine-stained housecoat with a faint urine odor. A half-eaten bowl of oatmeal is on the side table. Diane reports Margaret has refused more meals and lost about 8 lb over 3 months. Pill bottles are on the kitchen counter with tops off two bottles. A Wednesday-slot pill organizer is open, but today is Tuesday.
content.zh:
背景：Margaret 有3年阿尔茨海默病史，由记忆门诊随访。病史包括高血压（每日氨氯地平5 mg、赖诺普利10 mg）、双膝骨关节炎，以及5年前左髋骨折修复。因 Diane 无法请假，Margaret 已9个月未到记忆门诊复诊。

周二上午10:00初次表现：Diane 看起来疲惫、有黑眼圈，请了半天假，必须在中午前离开。中午后邻居会陪 Margaret 到 Diane 下班回来，但这只是非正式帮忙。Diane 报告 Margaret 昨晚醒来4次，凌晨2点试图外出。因为自己无法保持清醒，Diane 夜间把椅子抵在 Margaret 卧室门口。Diane 数周来连续睡眠不足4小时，2个月内减重12磅，上个月请病假3次，并说曾答应父亲绝不把 Margaret 送进机构。

Margaret 坐在躺椅上，穿着有尿渍且有淡淡尿味的家居服。边桌上有半碗燕麦。Diane 报告 Margaret 更常拒食，3个月内约减重8磅。厨房台面上有药瓶，其中两个瓶盖打开。星期三药格处于打开状态，但今天是星期二。

content.en:
Margaret: T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C), HR 76 regular, BP 148/88, RR 16, SpO₂ 97% room air. Weight 58 kg; weight 9 months ago was 61.6 kg. Alert, oriented only to first name; does not know date, season, or address. Follows one-step commands but not two-step commands. Speech fluent with word-finding pauses and occasional confabulation. Calls the nurse by her late husband's name twice. Skin intact with no bruising, lacerations, or pressure areas. Bilateral knee crepitus with mild swelling. Gait slow and wide-based with a slight forward lean; ambulates short distances independently. Grip strength symmetric and adequate. Oral mucosa slightly dry. Abdomen soft and non-tender. Perineal skin intact but mildly erythematous from urine contact. Diane reports urinary incontinence 2-3 times daily, pull-up briefs during the day, and no fecal incontinence.

Diane: Hands tremble slightly when opening pill bottles. Reports headaches almost daily, difficulty concentrating at work, and feeling angry then guilty when Margaret repeats questions. Denies thoughts of harming herself or Margaret. Has not seen her own primary care provider in over a year. Has not attended a caregiver support group and does not know what respite care is.

Home: Single-story ranch. Bathroom grab bars and hallway night-lights are present. Front door has a standard deadbolt Margaret can unlock. Stove knobs are not covered or disabled. Throw rugs are in the kitchen and hallway. Cleaning supplies are unlocked under the kitchen sink. A wooden chair is propped under the bedroom doorknob.

Labs from primary care office 1 week ago: sodium 141 mEq/L, potassium 4.2 mEq/L, BUN 24 mg/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, fasting glucose 102 mg/dL, albumin 3.1 g/dL, prealbumin 14 mg/dL, TSH 2.8 mIU/L, hemoglobin 11.8 g/dL, hematocrit 35%, WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL, platelets 210 ×10³/µL. Urinalysis: trace leukocytes, no nitrites, specific gravity 1.028.
content.zh:
Margaret：T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，HR 76次/分且规则，BP 148/88，RR 16次/分，室内空气下SpO₂ 97%。体重58 kg；9个月前体重61.6 kg。清醒，仅能说出自己的名字；不知道日期、季节或地址。能执行一步指令，不能执行两步指令。言语流利但有找词困难和偶发虚构。两次把护士称为已故丈夫的名字。皮肤完整，无瘀斑、裂伤或压迫部位损伤。双膝骨擦感伴轻度肿胀。步态缓慢、基底较宽、轻度前倾；可在家中短距离独立行走。握力对称且足够。口腔黏膜轻度干燥。腹部柔软、无压痛。会阴皮肤完整但因尿液接触轻度发红。Diane 报告每天尿失禁2–3次，白天穿拉拉裤，无大便失禁。

Diane：打开药瓶时双手轻微颤抖。报告几乎每天头痛，工作时难以集中注意力，当 Margaret 重复提问时会先愤怒后内疚。否认有伤害自己或 Margaret 的想法。已超过1年未看自己的初级保健医生。未参加过照护者支持小组，也不知道喘息服务是什么。

家庭环境：单层牧场式住宅。浴室有扶手，走廊有夜灯。前门是普通插销锁，Margaret 能打开。炉灶旋钮未加盖也未停用。厨房和走廊有小地毯。清洁用品未上锁，放在厨房水槽下方。卧室门把手下抵着一把木椅。

1周前初级保健诊所化验：钠141 mEq/L，钾4.2 mEq/L，BUN 24 mg/dL，肌酐0.9 mg/dL，空腹血糖102 mg/dL，白蛋白3.1 g/dL，前白蛋白14 mg/dL，TSH 2.8 mIU/L，血红蛋白11.8 g/dL，红细胞压积35%，WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL，血小板210 ×10³/µL。尿检：白细胞微量，亚硝酸盐阴性，比重1.028。

title.zh: 激动 episode 与照护者反应

content.en: While the nurse assesses the home, Margaret stands without warning, walks toward the kitchen, and turns on a stove burner. Diane rushes to turn it off and says Margaret thinks she is making coffee; last week Margaret left a burner on for 20 minutes before Diane noticed. Margaret becomes mildly agitated when redirected, pulls her arm from Diane's grasp, and says loudly, 'Don't touch me! I want my coffee!' Diane raises her voice: 'Mom, stop it! You can't use the stove!' Margaret paces, wrings her hands, and repeats, 'Where is Frank? I want Frank.' Diane sits at the kitchen table, puts her head in her hands, and says quietly, 'I can't do this anymore. I'm failing her.' Diane does not strike, shove, or physically restrain Margaret; her frustration is verbal and self-directed. Margaret's vital signs during agitation are HR 92, BP 156/94, RR 20. She calms after about 10 minutes when the nurse offers decaffeinated tea and speaks slowly and calmly. After calming: HR 78, BP 144/86, RR 16.
content.zh: 护士评估家庭环境时，Margaret 突然站起，走向厨房并打开炉灶。Diane 赶紧关掉炉灶，并说 Margaret 以为自己在煮咖啡；上周 Margaret 曾把炉灶开着20分钟，Diane 才发现。被转移注意时，Margaret 轻度激动，把手从 Diane 手中抽出，大声说：‘别碰我！我要咖啡！’Diane 提高音量：‘妈，停下！你不能用炉灶！’Margaret 来回踱步、绞手，并重复：‘Frank 在哪？我要 Frank。’Diane 坐在厨房桌旁，双手抱头，低声说：‘我撑不下去了。我辜负了她。’Diane 没有打、推或身体限制 Margaret；她的挫败表现为言语和自责。Margaret 激动时生命体征为HR 92、BP 156/94、RR 20。护士提供无咖啡因茶，并用缓慢平静语气陪伴后，约10分钟后 Margaret 平静。平静后：HR 78、BP 144/86、RR 16。

title.en: Stage 2 — Later the same visit, 11:30 AM-noon

content.en: With Margaret calm and seated, the nurse speaks privately with Diane. Diane reports crushing Margaret's amlodipine and lisinopril tablets into applesauce because Margaret spits out pills; Diane is unsure whether Margaret swallows all the applesauce. She estimates Margaret receives most medications most days but missed them entirely 2 days last week because Diane overslept. Margaret fell in the bathroom 3 days ago, with no visible injury; Diane helped her up but did not report the fall because she feared being judged. Diane's brother recently told her she 'just needs to try harder.' The nurse confirms today's Tuesday medication compartment is still full and Wednesday's compartment is empty. Diane says she must have mixed up the days and cannot keep track anymore. Diane has also been giving diphenhydramine 25 mg at bedtime for 3 weeks to help Margaret sleep; it worked at first but now Margaret seems more confused in the morning.
content.zh: Margaret 平静坐下后，护士与 Diane 私下交谈。Diane 报告因 Margaret 会吐出药片，她把 Margaret 的氨氯地平和赖诺普利压碎混入苹果泥；但她不确定 Margaret 是否吃完所有苹果泥。她估计 Margaret 大多数天能吃到大多数药，但上周有2天因为 Diane 睡过头而完全漏服。3天前 Margaret 在浴室跌倒，没有可见外伤；Diane 扶她起来但没有报告，因为害怕被评判。Diane 的哥哥最近说她‘只需要再努力一点’。护士确认今天星期二的药格仍满，星期三药格为空。Diane 说自己一定把日期弄混了，已经无法跟上。Diane 还连续3周在睡前给 Margaret 苯海拉明25 mg帮助睡眠；最初有效，但现在 Margaret 早晨似乎更混乱。

title.en: Stage 3 — Follow-up home visit, five days later

content.en:
Since the first visit, the nurse coordinated a social-work referral, gave Diane Area Agency on Aging and caregiver support group contact information, and contacted the primary care provider about diphenhydramine use, the unreported fall, medication difficulties, weight loss, and BP readings. The provider discontinued diphenhydramine, ordered a pharmacy consultation for alternative formulations, referred Margaret to physical therapy for fall-risk assessment, and referred her to a dietitian.

Diane called the Area Agency on Aging and learned about an adult day program 3 miles away that operates Monday-Friday, 8 AM-4 PM. She is thinking about enrollment. She attended one online caregiver support group and felt less alone. She removed the chair from the bedroom door and installed a front-door alarm that chimes when the door opens. She has not addressed the stove, throw rugs, or unlocked cleaning supplies. Margaret's medications have been given daily with a phone alarm. The pharmacy delivered amlodipine oral liquid, which Margaret accepts in juice. Lisinopril is still crushed in applesauce after pharmacist confirmation that the tablet is crushable.

Margaret appears slightly more alert. Diane reports Margaret slept through the night twice in 5 days since diphenhydramine stopped, with less morning confusion on those days. Urinary incontinence continues 2-3 times daily. Meal intake over the past 2 days is about 50%, improved from the prior 25%-30% estimate. Weight is 57.6 kg, down 0.4 kg from 5 days ago; this trend is too short to interpret definitively. Vitals: T 98.4 °F (36.9 °C), HR 74, BP 138/82, RR 16, SpO₂ 98%. Perineal erythema is unchanged. No new falls. Margaret tried to open the front door once at night; the alarm woke Diane, who redirected her without incident. Diane reports some sleep improvement, fewer headaches, and a primary-care appointment next week, but still has no formal respite in place.
content.zh:
自第一次访视后，护士协调社工转介，提供老龄事务机构和照护者支持小组联系方式，并就苯海拉明使用、未报告跌倒、用药困难、体重下降和血压读数联系初级保健医生。医生停用了苯海拉明，开出药师会诊以寻找替代剂型，转介物理治疗评估跌倒风险，并转介营养师。

Diane 联系了老龄事务机构，得知距家3英里的成人日间照护项目，周一至周五8:00–16:00开放。她正在考虑报名。她参加了一次线上照护者支持小组，感觉不那么孤单。她移除了卧室门口的椅子，并安装了前门警报器，门打开时会响。她尚未处理炉灶、小地毯或未上锁清洁用品。Margaret 通过手机提醒已每日服药。药房送来了氨氯地平口服液，Margaret 可用果汁服用。经药师确认赖诺普利片可压碎后，仍压碎混入苹果泥。

Margaret 看起来稍微更清醒。Diane 报告自停用苯海拉明后的5天中，Margaret 有2晚睡整夜，且这些天早晨混乱减少。尿失禁仍每天2–3次。过去2天进食约50%，比之前估计的25%–30%有所改善。体重57.6 kg，比5天前下降0.4 kg；该趋势太短，不能定论。生命体征：T 98.4 °F (36.9 °C)，HR 74，BP 138/82，RR 16，SpO₂ 98%。会阴发红未变。无新跌倒。Margaret 夜间曾试图打开前门一次；警报叫醒 Diane，Diane 将她重新引导回床，无意外。Diane 报告睡眠有所改善、头痛减少，并已预约下周初级保健，但尚未落实正式喘息服务。

stem.en: Using the Stage 1 home-visit data, highlight the findings that are significant cues requiring nursing attention.
stem.zh: 根据第1阶段居家访视资料，标出需要护理关注的重要线索。

stem.en: At the Stage 3 follow-up, classify each finding as evidence of improvement, a remaining gap requiring follow-up, or a finding that should be monitored but is not decisive over this short interval.
stem.zh: 在第3阶段复诊时，将每项发现分类为改善证据、仍需跟进的缺口，或需要监测但在短期内不能作为决定性依据的发现。

stem.en: At Stage 2, which interpretation of the findings and nursing response is most appropriate?
stem.zh: 在第2阶段，哪一种对评估发现的解释和护理回应最合适？

options.en: The home situation is unsalvageable because Diane missed a clinic appointment, so the nurse should recommend immediate removal from the home as the first response.
options.zh: 由于 Diane 错过了门诊复诊，居家照护已无法挽回，因此护士的第一反应应是建议立即离家安置。

options.en: The problem is only medication nonadherence; the nurse should focus on the pill organizer and avoid discussing caregiver stress or home hazards.
options.zh: 问题只是服药不依从；护士应只关注药盒，避免讨论照护者压力或居家危险。

options.en: Because Margaret has no bruises or lacerations, the nurse should reassure Diane that no safety documentation or follow-up is needed.
options.zh: 因为 Margaret 没有瘀斑或裂伤，护士应安慰 Diane 不需要安全记录或跟进。

options.en: The chair barricade and raised voice prove intentional physical abuse, so the nurse should accuse Diane and demand immediate facility placement before completing the assessment.
options.zh: 椅子挡门和提高音量证明存在故意身体虐待，因此护士应指责 Diane，并在完成评估前要求立即机构安置。

options.en: The pattern best supports caregiver role strain with unsafe compensatory strategies; respond nonjudgmentally, correct immediate hazards, document, notify the provider/supervisor or social work, and follow agency/state APS policy if neglect is suspected or safety cannot be maintained.
options.zh: 该模式最支持照护者角色压力并伴有不安全的补偿性做法；应以非评判方式回应，纠正即时危险，记录，通知医师/主管或社工，并在怀疑忽视或无法维持安全时按机构/州政策联系成人保护服务。

correct.en: Diane's behavior is unsafe but the overall pattern is most consistent with caregiver role strain: she is exhausted, guilty, tearful, receptive to help, and voluntarily requested support. The nurse should not ignore the hazards or excuse unsafe care; the correct response is nonjudgmental support plus documentation, team notification, safety planning, and policy-guided APS reporting assessment if safety cannot be maintained or neglect is suspected.
correct.zh: Diane 的做法不安全，但整体模式最符合照护者角色压力：她疲惫、内疚、哭泣、愿意接受帮助，并主动请求支持。护士不能忽视危险或纵容不安全照护；正确回应是非评判支持，同时记录、通知团队、制定安全计划，并在无法维持安全或怀疑忽视时按政策评估是否需报告成人保护服务。

byChoice.en: This response matches the total pattern and preserves the therapeutic relationship while still addressing safety and reporting obligations.
byChoice.zh: 该回应符合整体模式，在处理安全和报告责任的同时保持治疗性关系。

byChoice.en: Immediate removal is not the first response when Diane denies intent to harm, is receptive to help, and the hazards are modifiable with urgent support and monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 当 Diane 否认伤害意图、愿意接受帮助，且危险可通过紧急支持和监测来改善时，立即离家安置不是第一反应。

byChoice.en: Medication errors matter, but they are only one part of a larger pattern involving caregiver exhaustion, elopement, stove safety, nutrition, and incontinence.
byChoice.zh: 用药错误很重要，但只是更大问题的一部分，包括照护者疲惫、走失、炉灶安全、营养和失禁。

byChoice.en: Absence of bruising lowers concern for inflicted injury but does not make the home safe or remove documentation and follow-up duties.
byChoice.zh: 没有瘀斑可降低人为外伤的担忧，但不能说明居家环境安全，也不能免除记录和跟进责任。

byChoice.en: The barricade and raised voice are serious cues, but they do not by themselves prove intentional physical abuse; accusing Diane prematurely can damage trust and does not replace safety planning.
byChoice.zh: 挡门和提高音量是严重线索，但不能单独证明故意身体虐待；过早指责 Diane 会破坏信任，也不能替代安全计划。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not classify elder-safety cases from one cue alone. Compare intent, injury pattern, caregiver affect, willingness to accept help, and whether hazards can be modified.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要仅凭单一线索判断老年人安全问题。要比较意图、损伤模式、照护者情绪、接受帮助的意愿，以及危险是否可改变。

stem.en: Which interventions should the nurse include in the Stage 2 home-safety and caregiver-support plan? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 护士应将哪些干预纳入第2阶段的居家安全和照护者支持计划？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Contact the provider and pharmacist about medication formulations and diphenhydramine use; set up alarms, a written schedule, and a clarified pill-organizer routine.
options.zh: 就药物剂型和苯海拉明使用联系医师及药师；设置提醒、书面时间表，并明确药盒流程。

options.en: Remove the bedroom-door barricade and use door alarms or contact sensors on exterior doors; consider medical identification and a local wandering-response program.
options.zh: 移除卧室挡门，在外门使用门警报或门磁感应器；考虑医疗识别饰品和当地走失应对项目。

options.en: Continue diphenhydramine at a lower dose and keep the chair barricade until Margaret stops wandering.
options.zh: 继续较低剂量苯海拉明，并保留椅子挡门，直到 Margaret 停止走失。

options.en: Remove throw rugs, lock cleaning supplies, maintain lighting, and coordinate physical therapy for gait and fall-risk assessment.
options.zh: 移除小地毯，锁好清洁用品，保持照明，并协调物理治疗评估步态和跌倒风险。

options.en: Prevent unsupervised stove use by using knob covers, removing knobs, or disconnecting the stove when not supervised.
options.zh: 通过旋钮保护盖、取下旋钮，或在无人看护时断开炉灶，防止无人看护使用炉灶。

options.en: Address nutrition, incontinence, and caregiver support with dietitian referral, preferred small frequent meals, prompted toileting, moisture barrier, social work, Area Agency on Aging, adult day program, caregiver support group, and Diane's own primary-care visit.
options.zh: 通过营养师转介、少量多餐且选择偏好食物、定时提醒如厕、皮肤屏障霜、社工、老龄事务机构、成人日间照护、照护者支持小组以及 Diane 自己的初级保健就诊，处理营养、失禁和照护者支持。

correct.en: The plan must address both sides of the dyad: Margaret's safety risks and Diane's ability to continue caregiving. Appropriate interventions include nonrestrictive wandering alerts, stove control, fall and hazardous-material prevention, medication-formulation and reminder support, provider notification about diphenhydramine, nutrition and incontinence support, respite/adult day resources, social work, caregiver support, and Diane's own health care.
correct.zh: 计划必须同时处理照护关系中的两方面：Margaret 的安全风险和 Diane 持续照护的能力。合适干预包括非限制性走失警报、炉灶控制、跌倒和危险物预防、药物剂型与提醒支持、向医师报告苯海拉明、营养和失禁支持、喘息服务/成人日间照护资源、社工、照护者支持以及 Diane 自身就医。

byChoice.en: Diphenhydramine can worsen confusion and falls in older adults with dementia, and a chair barricade is an unsafe restriction rather than a safe wandering strategy.
byChoice.zh: 苯海拉明可加重老年痴呆患者的混乱和跌倒风险，而椅子挡门是不安全限制，不是安全的走失管理策略。

byChoice.en: Medication errors and OTC diphenhydramine use require provider/pharmacist involvement and a simpler routine.
byChoice.zh: 用药错误和非处方苯海拉明使用需要医师/药师介入，并建立更简单的流程。

byChoice.en: Stove control is necessary because Margaret has already turned on a burner without safe supervision.
byChoice.zh: 必须控制炉灶，因为 Margaret 已经在缺乏安全看护时打开过炉灶。

byChoice.en: Door alarms reduce elopement risk without confining Margaret behind a barricade.
byChoice.zh: 门警报可降低走失风险，同时避免用挡门限制 Margaret。

byChoice.en: Nutrition, skin protection, incontinence management, respite, and caregiver health are all required for a sustainable home plan.
byChoice.zh: 营养、皮肤保护、失禁管理、喘息服务和照护者健康都是可持续居家计划所必需的。

byChoice.en: Fall and poisoning hazards are modifiable environmental risks in this home.
byChoice.zh: 跌倒和中毒危险是该家庭中可改变的环境风险。

testTakingStrategy.en: For SATA care-plan items, select interventions that are specific, actionable, and tied to a cue. Avoid vague advice or actions that continue the unsafe workaround.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 在多选护理计划题中，选择具体、可执行且与线索相对应的干预。避免模糊建议或延续不安全权宜做法的行动。

stem.en: During Stage 1, after Margaret is safely away from the stove and Diane says, 'I can't do this anymore. I'm failing her,' which nurse response is most therapeutic?
stem.zh: 第1阶段，当 Margaret 已安全远离炉灶，而 Diane 说‘我撑不下去了，我辜负了她’时，护士哪种回应最具治疗性？

options.en: Immediately list every community resource and safety modification without first responding to Diane's statement that she is failing.
options.zh: 不先回应 Diane 说自己失败了，而是立即列出所有社区资源和安全改造。

options.en: After confirming Margaret is away from the stove, say: 'This is incredibly hard, and I can see how exhausted you are. Asking for help does not mean you are failing her. Let's take this one step at a time together.'
options.zh: 确认 Margaret 已远离炉灶后说：‘这真的非常不容易，我看得出你已经很疲惫。寻求帮助并不表示你辜负了她。我们一起一步一步来。’

options.en: Tell Diane to leave the room so the nurse can correct Margaret's behavior without family interference.
options.zh: 告诉 Diane 离开房间，让护士在没有家属干扰的情况下纠正 Margaret 的行为。

options.en: Say: 'You are doing a great job, and everything will get easier once she settles down.'
options.zh: 说：‘你做得很好，等她安定下来一切都会变容易。’

options.en: Say: 'You cannot raise your voice at a person with dementia; if you keep doing that, I will have to report you.'
options.zh: 说：‘你不能对痴呆患者提高音量；如果你继续这样，我就必须举报你。’

correct.en: The nurse first ensures immediate safety, then validates Diane's exhaustion and guilt without judgment. This builds trust and opens the door to later education and safety planning. Lecturing, threatening, false reassurance, premature resource-listing, or excluding Diane bypasses the emotional cue and can reduce engagement.
correct.zh: 护士首先确保即时安全，然后以非评判方式接纳 Diane 的疲惫和内疚。这能建立信任，为之后教育和安全计划打基础。说教、威胁、虚假安慰、过早罗列资源或排除 Diane 都会绕过情绪线索，并可能降低参与度。

byChoice.en: Resources are needed later, but immediately listing them bypasses Diane's emotional statement.
byChoice.zh: 之后确实需要资源，但立即罗列资源会绕过 Diane 的情绪表达。

byChoice.en: Removing Diane from the interaction frames her as interference rather than a distressed caregiver who needs support and coaching.
byChoice.zh: 让 Diane 离开会把她视为干扰者，而不是需要支持和指导的痛苦照护者。

byChoice.en: This validates the caregiver's distress and reframes help-seeking as appropriate, not failure.
byChoice.zh: 该回应接纳照护者的痛苦，并将寻求帮助重新定义为合适行为，而不是失败。

byChoice.en: This is false reassurance because the situation is not safe or easy, and it dismisses Diane's real distress.
byChoice.zh: 这是虚假安慰，因为情况并不安全也不容易，并且忽视了 Diane 的真实痛苦。

byChoice.en: This is judgmental and threatening; it may shut down disclosure and does not first establish trust.
byChoice.zh: 这带有评判和威胁，可能使对方停止透露信息，也没有先建立信任。

testTakingStrategy.en: In therapeutic communication, answer the feeling before the fact list. Validate distress, avoid false reassurance, and preserve safety.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 治疗性沟通题中，先回应情绪，再处理事实清单。要接纳痛苦、避免虚假安慰，并维持安全。

stem.en: After the Stage 2 disclosures, which priority should the nurse address before leaving the home today?
stem.zh: 在第2阶段补充信息后，护士今天离开该家庭前应优先处理什么？

options.en: Defer environmental changes until the follow-up visit because Margaret is currently calm.
options.zh: 因为 Margaret 目前平静，所以将环境改变推迟到复诊时再处理。

options.en: Focus first on rechecking the blood pressure and teaching Diane to restart the Wednesday pill compartment tomorrow.
options.zh: 首先重新测量血压，并教 Diane 明天重新使用星期三药格。

options.en: Before Diane leaves today, ensure Margaret is not left in an unsafe environment: remove the bedroom-door barricade, use a nonrestrictive door-alert strategy, prevent unsupervised stove access, orient the neighbor to safety monitoring and emergency contacts, and notify the provider about diphenhydramine use.
options.zh: 在 Diane 今天离开前，确保 Margaret 不会被留在不安全环境中：移除卧室挡门，采用非限制性的门警报策略，防止无人看护时接触炉灶，向邻居说明安全看护和紧急联系方式，并通知医师有关苯海拉明使用情况。

options.en: Schedule a caregiver support group before addressing the stove, door, or neighbor supervision plan.
options.zh: 先安排照护者支持小组，再处理炉灶、门或邻居看护计划。

options.en: Prioritize a dietary consult and weekly weights because the albumin and prealbumin are low.
options.zh: 优先安排营养会诊和每周称重，因为白蛋白和前白蛋白偏低。

correct.en: The immediate threat is that Margaret may be left with uncontrolled elopement and stove hazards while Diane returns to work. The nurse must replace the unsafe barricade with a nonrestrictive alert strategy, control stove access, orient the temporary caregiver, and contact the provider about diphenhydramine because it worsens confusion and compounds fall and wandering risk. Nutrition, BP, and caregiver support are important but not the most immediate life-safety threats before Diane leaves.
correct.zh: 即时威胁是 Diane 回去上班后，Margaret 可能面临未控制的走失和炉灶危险。护士必须用非限制性警报策略替代不安全挡门，控制炉灶接触，指导临时照护者，并就苯海拉明联系医师，因为它会加重意识混乱并增加跌倒和走失风险。营养、血压和照护者支持都重要，但不是 Diane 离开前最紧迫的生命安全威胁。

byChoice.en: Blood pressure and pill-organizer correction are important, but they do not control the immediate environmental threats.
byChoice.zh: 血压和药盒纠正很重要，但不能控制即时环境危险。

byChoice.en: Current calmness does not remove the risk; Margaret already turned on a burner and attempted nighttime elopement.
byChoice.zh: 目前平静并不消除风险；Margaret 已经打开过炉灶，也曾夜间试图离家。

byChoice.en: Support groups help sustainability but do not protect Margaret during today's period of supervision by the neighbor.
byChoice.zh: 支持小组有助于长期维持，但不能保护 Margaret 今天由邻居看护期间的安全。

byChoice.en: This option addresses the immediate elopement, fire/burn, temporary supervision, and medication-related confusion risks before Diane leaves.
byChoice.zh: 该选项在 Diane 离开前处理走失、火灾/烧伤、临时看护和药物相关混乱等即时风险。

byChoice.en: Nutritional decline needs follow-up, but it is less immediate than a client turning on burners or leaving the house unsafely.
byChoice.zh: 营养下降需要跟进，但不如患者打开炉灶或不安全离家那样紧迫。

testTakingStrategy.en: When several problems are real, choose the action that prevents the most immediate serious harm before the next handoff or period of reduced supervision.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当多个问题都真实存在时，选择能在下一次交接或看护减少前防止最即时严重伤害的行动。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items about discharge readiness and care coordination.
stem.zh: 查看患者病历，并回答有关出院准备情况和护理协调的病例题。

title.en: Unfolding case: discharge coordination after right total hip arthroplasty
title.zh: 展开病例：右全髋关节置换术后的出院协调

summary.en: An 82-year-old Mandarin-speaking client is recovering from elective right total hip arthroplasty. The nurse must coordinate language access, mobility readiness, medication safety, home health services, and handoff planning before discharge home.
summary.zh: 一名82岁、主要讲普通话的患者正在从择期右全髋关节置换术中恢复。护士必须在患者回家出院前协调语言服务、活动能力准备、用药安全、居家护理服务和交接计划。

title.en: Postoperative day 0: admission record and initial assessment
title.zh: 术后第0天：入院记录和初始评估

content.en:
1530: Mrs. Chen, age 82, is admitted to the orthopedic surgical unit after uncomplicated elective right total hip arthroplasty for osteoarthritis. Primary language: Mandarin. She can exchange simple greetings in English but cannot reliably discuss medications, follow multistep instructions, or read English discharge documents. She lives alone in a second-floor walk-up apartment. Her adult son lives 2 hours away and works full-time. She does not own a smartphone and uses a corded landline at home.

History: hypertension, mild chronic kidney disease (baseline creatinine 1.3 mg/dL, eGFR 42 mL/min), and type 2 diabetes. No history of venous thromboembolism.

Orders: rivaroxaban 10 mg PO daily for 35 days for VTE prophylaxis; acetaminophen 1 g PO every 6 hr scheduled; oxycodone 5 mg PO every 4 hr PRN breakthrough pain; home amlodipine and metformin; incentive spirometry every 1-2 hr while awake; sequential compression devices while in bed; physical therapy consult on postoperative day 1; posterior hip precautions: no flexion beyond 90 degrees, no internal rotation, and no adduction past midline.

Initial findings at 1600: T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C), HR 82, BP 138/78, RR 16, SpO₂ 96% on 2 L nasal cannula. Alert and oriented to person and place with interpreter phone assistance. Pain 5/10. Dressing clean, dry, intact; drain output 50 mL sanguineous since OR. Right pedal pulse 2+, capillary refill <3 sec, sensation intact, and dorsiflexion/plantarflexion present. Foley catheter draining clear yellow urine. Call light within reach and bed alarm activated. The nurse observes the client leaning across the bed rail for water, suggesting she may not understand fall-prevention instructions.

Baseline labs: Hgb 10.8 g/dL (pre-op 12.1), Hct 32%, platelets 198 ×10³/µL, WBC 9.2 ×10³/µL, INR 1.0, aPTT 28 sec, BUN 24 mg/dL, creatinine 1.4 mg/dL, eGFR 38 mL/min, K⁺ 4.0 mEq/L, Na⁺ 139 mEq/L, glucose 162 mg/dL, albumin 3.1 g/dL.

Chart concern: Mandarin is listed as the primary language. Informed consent was signed with an interpreter present, but no ongoing postoperative language-access plan is documented.
content.zh:
1530：陈女士，82岁，因骨关节炎接受择期右全髋关节置换术后入住骨科外科病区，手术过程无并发症。主要语言：普通话。她能用英语进行简单问候，但不能可靠地讨论药物、执行多步骤指令或阅读英文出院文件。她独自住在二楼无电梯公寓。成年儿子住在2小时车程外，并全职工作。她没有智能手机，家中使用有线座机。

病史：高血压、轻度慢性肾病（基础肌酐1.3 mg/dL，eGFR 42 mL/min）和2型糖尿病。无静脉血栓栓塞史。

医嘱：利伐沙班10 mg口服每日一次，共35天，用于VTE预防；对乙酰氨基酚1 g口服每6小时定时；羟考酮5 mg口服每4小时按需用于突破性疼痛；继续家庭剂量的氨氯地平和二甲双胍；清醒时每1–2小时使用激励肺量计；卧床时使用序贯加压装置；术后第1天物理治疗会诊；后路髋关节置换注意事项：髋屈曲不超过90度、不得内旋、不得内收越过中线。

1600初始评估：体温98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，心率82次/分，血压138/78 mmHg，呼吸16次/分，SpO₂ 96%（鼻导管2 L）。借助电话解释服务评估，患者能辨认本人和地点。疼痛5/10。敷料清洁、干燥、完整；从手术室至今引流出血性液体50 mL。右足背动脉搏动2+，毛细血管再充盈<3秒，感觉完整，可背屈和跖屈。导尿管引流清亮黄色尿液。呼叫铃在可及范围内，床报警已开启。护士观察到患者越过床栏伸手拿水，提示她可能不理解防跌倒指示。

基础实验室：血红蛋白10.8 g/dL（术前12.1），血细胞比容32%，血小板198 ×10³/µL，白细胞9.2 ×10³/µL，INR 1.0，aPTT 28秒，BUN 24 mg/dL，肌酐1.4 mg/dL，eGFR 38 mL/min，K⁺ 4.0 mEq/L，Na⁺ 139 mEq/L，血糖162 mg/dL，白蛋白3.1 g/dL。

病历关注点：病历列明主要语言为普通话。知情同意书在解释员在场时签署，但未记录术后持续语言服务计划。

title.zh: 术后第1天：出院准备筛查

title.en: Morning assessment, PT note, and education attempt
title.zh: 晨间评估、物理治疗记录和健康教育尝试

content.en:
About 18 hr after surgery: T 99 °F (37.2 °C), HR 78, BP 132/74, RR 14, SpO₂ 97% on room air. Pain 4/10 at rest and 7/10 with movement using an interpreter phone. Drain removed per order; incision approximated with staples, mild ecchymosis, no erythema, and scant serous drainage. Foley removed; client voided 250 mL. Oral medications tolerated.

Repeat labs: Hgb 10.2 g/dL, creatinine 1.5 mg/dL, eGFR 36 mL/min, glucose 148 mg/dL.

PT session: Client sits at the edge of the bed and stands with a front-wheeled walker using moderate assistance from two people. She is unsteady, attempts to lift the walker, loses balance once but is caught by PT, and cannot safely rise from a standard-height chair independently. PT documents that she is not safe for discharge home without continued walker training and a home-safety evaluation. PT recommends at least two more sessions and home PT after discharge.

Teaching attempt: The nurse attempts hip-precaution and anticoagulant teaching using an English handout. The client nods and smiles but cannot demonstrate understanding. With interpreter phone assistance, she cannot state the medication name, purpose, bleeding signs to report, or what to do if a dose is missed. The nurse documents failed teach-back and the need for a certified Mandarin interpreter for comprehensive discharge teaching.

Unresolved discharge barriers: lives alone with no confirmed support for the first 48-72 hr; unsafe walker use; discharge teaching incomplete because of language barrier; no home health referral; uncertain rivaroxaban adherence; second-floor walk-up with no stair assessment; no confirmed follow-up appointment; creatinine trending upward while receiving a renally cleared anticoagulant.
content.zh:
术后约18小时：体温99 °F (37.2 °C)，心率78次/分，血压132/74 mmHg，呼吸14次/分，室内空气SpO₂ 97%。通过电话解释服务评估，静息疼痛4/10，活动时疼痛7/10。按医嘱拔除引流管；切口以皮钉闭合，轻度瘀斑，无红斑，少量浆液性渗液。拔除导尿管；患者自行排尿250 mL。可耐受口服药物。

复查实验室：血红蛋白10.2 g/dL，肌酐1.5 mg/dL，eGFR 36 mL/min，血糖148 mg/dL。

物理治疗记录：患者可在床边坐起，并在两人中等协助下使用前轮助行器站立。她步态不稳，试图把助行器抬起，曾失去平衡一次但被物理治疗师扶住，且无法独立安全地从标准高度椅子上站起。物理治疗记录显示，在继续助行器训练和居家安全评估之前，患者尚不适合回家出院。PT建议至少再进行两次训练，并在出院后安排居家物理治疗。

健康教育尝试：护士使用英文资料讲解髋关节注意事项和抗凝药。患者点头微笑，但不能证明理解。借助电话解释服务，她不能说出药名、用途、需报告的出血征象或漏服后的处理。护士记录回教失败，并记录需要合格普通话医疗解释员进行全面出院教育。

未解决的出院障碍：独居且最初48–72小时无确认照护者；助行器使用不安全；因语言障碍出院教育未完成；未转介居家护理；利伐沙班依从性不确定；二楼无电梯且尚未评估上下楼梯能力；未确认随访预约；正在使用经肾脏清除的抗凝药且肌酐上升。

title.en: Coordination update, renal trend, and teach-back session
title.zh: 协调进展、肾功能趋势和回教环节

content.en:
About 42 hr after surgery: T 98.4 °F (36.9 °C), HR 74, BP 128/72, RR 14, SpO₂ 98% on room air. Pain 3/10 at rest and 5/10 with movement. Incision clean with staples intact and no signs of infection. Repeat creatinine 1.4 mg/dL after hydration and adequate oral intake; eGFR 39 mL/min. Hgb 10.0 g/dL.

Social work/case management interviews the client using a telephone interpreter. Her son can be present on the day of discharge and the following day, but not beyond that. She receives Meals on Wheels and has Medicare with a supplemental plan. Case management determines that she qualifies for Medicare home health services because she is homebound and requires skilled nursing plus home PT. The home health referral is initiated.

PT session: Client demonstrates safe walker use on level ground with standby assistance and can perform sit-to-stand from a raised toilet seat independently. Stairs have not yet been attempted. Afternoon PT stair training is planned.

Interpreter-mediated education: A certified in-person Mandarin interpreter is present. The nurse teaches posterior hip precautions, rivaroxaban purpose and 10 mg once-daily schedule for 35 days, bleeding signs, missed-dose instructions, pain medication safety, and when to call the surgeon or seek emergency care. The client accurately repeats key points in Mandarin, demonstrates hip precautions with a model, and identifies the rivaroxaban pill. She states she would need her son to call the surgeon because she cannot navigate the English phone tree alone. The nurse flags this as a remaining barrier.

Afternoon PT: Client negotiates four stairs up and down with a walker and one handrail with standby assistance. PT clears her for discharge home with home PT, front-wheeled walker, raised toilet seat, and reacher/grabber. The nurse requests a Mandarin-translated home exercise program. The surgeon writes a discharge order for postoperative day 3 morning pending nursing confirmation of discharge readiness.
content.zh:
术后约42小时：体温98.4 °F (36.9 °C)，心率74次/分，血压128/72 mmHg，呼吸14次/分，室内空气SpO₂ 98%。静息疼痛3/10，活动时5/10。切口清洁，皮钉完整，无感染迹象。补液并充分口服摄入后复查肌酐1.4 mg/dL，eGFR 39 mL/min。血红蛋白10.0 g/dL。

社会工作/个案管理通过电话解释员访谈患者。她的儿子可在出院当天和次日陪伴，但之后不能继续陪伴。她接受送餐服务，并有Medicare及补充保险。个案管理判断，由于她居家受限且需要专业护理和居家物理治疗，符合Medicare居家护理服务条件。居家护理转介已启动。

物理治疗：患者在平地使用助行器时仅需旁站协助，可独立从加高马桶座上坐站转换。尚未尝试楼梯。计划下午进行楼梯训练。

解释员参与的健康教育：合格的现场普通话医疗解释员在场。护士讲解后路髋关节注意事项、利伐沙班用途及10 mg每日一次共35天的服药安排、出血征象、漏服处理、止痛药安全，以及何时联系外科医生或急诊就医。患者能用普通话准确复述要点，用模型示范髋关节注意事项，并能辨认利伐沙班药片。她表示若有问题需让儿子致电外科医生，因为她无法独自应对英文电话系统。护士将此标记为剩余障碍。

下午物理治疗：患者在旁站协助下使用助行器和一侧扶手上下四级台阶。PT同意其在安排居家PT、前轮助行器、加高马桶座和取物器后回家出院。护士要求康复部门提供普通话版居家运动计划。外科医生开具术后第3天上午出院医嘱，前提是护士确认出院准备充分。

title.en: Postoperative day 3: final discharge verification and handoff
title.zh: 术后第3天：最终出院核查和交接

content.en:
About 66 hr after surgery: T 98.1 °F (36.7 °C), HR 72, BP 126/70, RR 14, SpO₂ 99% on room air. Pain 2/10 at rest and 4/10 with movement, controlled with scheduled acetaminophen alone; client declined the last two oxycodone doses. Incision clean and dry. Creatinine 1.3 mg/dL, eGFR 42 mL/min. Hgb 9.8 g/dL and stable. Glucose 132 mg/dL.

Final readiness verification: The Visiting Nurse Association accepts the referral. First home visit for skilled nursing and PT is confirmed for the day after discharge. The nurse calls the receiving home health nurse using SBAR and communicates language needs, the need for an interpreter for teaching, social situation, functional status, equipment, rivaroxaban dose/duration and adherence concerns, renal-function trend, bleeding surveillance, son's role as the communication contact, and the confirmed follow-up appointment. The home health agency confirms that a Mandarin-speaking home health aide is available.

The nurse calls the surgeon's office to confirm the 2-week follow-up appointment and requests that a Mandarin interpreter be scheduled. The son arrives at 0900. With video interpreter assistance, the nurse reviews discharge instructions with the client and son together, confirms that the son understands how to reach the surgeon's office, provides the home health agency phone number, and gives the client a 7-day pill organizer labeled in Mandarin. The client is discharged at 1030 by wheelchair to her son's car with the walker, raised toilet seat, and reacher/grabber. The nurse documents that all identified discharge barriers are resolved or have a confirmed community plan of care.
content.zh:
术后约66小时：体温98.1 °F (36.7 °C)，心率72次/分，血压126/70 mmHg，呼吸14次/分，室内空气SpO₂ 99%。静息疼痛2/10，活动时4/10，仅用定时对乙酰氨基酚即可控制；患者拒绝了最近两次羟考酮。切口清洁干燥。肌酐1.3 mg/dL，eGFR 42 mL/min。血红蛋白9.8 g/dL且稳定。血糖132 mg/dL。

最终出院准备核查：访问护士协会接受转介。已确认出院后次日进行首次居家专业护理和物理治疗。护士使用SBAR致电接收的居家护理护士，沟通语言需求、所有教学需使用解释员、社会情况、功能状态、设备、利伐沙班剂量/疗程及依从性关注点、肾功能趋势、出血监测、儿子作为沟通联系人，以及已确认的随访预约。居家护理机构确认可安排会普通话的居家护理助理。

护士致电外科医生办公室确认2周随访预约，并要求安排普通话解释员。儿子于0900到达。护士借助视频解释员与患者和儿子共同复习出院说明，确认儿子知道如何联系外科医生办公室，提供居家护理机构电话号码，并给患者一盒以普通话标注的7天药盒。患者于1030坐轮椅至儿子的汽车，助行器、加高马桶座和取物器一并带走。护士记录所有已识别的出院障碍均已解决，或已有确认的社区照护计划。

stem.en: Postoperative day 0: The admission record lists Mandarin as the client's primary language, but no ongoing postoperative language-access plan is documented. Which action should the nurse take first?
stem.zh: 术后第0天：入院记录显示患者主要语言为普通话，但未记录持续的术后语言服务计划。护士首先应采取哪项措施？

stem.en: Postoperative day 1: The nurse uses an English handout to teach hip precautions and rivaroxaban safety. With interpreter phone assistance, the client cannot state the medication name, purpose, bleeding signs, or missed-dose instructions. Which nursing action is best?
stem.zh: 术后第1天：护士用英文资料讲解髋关节注意事项和利伐沙班安全。借助电话解释服务，患者仍不能说出药名、用途、出血征象或漏服处理。哪项护理措施最佳？

stem.en: Postoperative day 1: The client is medically stable, but the discharge-readiness screen shows unsafe walker use, no confirmed home support, no home health referral, incomplete teaching, no stair assessment, and a rising creatinine while taking rivaroxaban. Which nursing actions are necessary to address the discharge barriers before the client goes home? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 术后第1天：患者医学状况稳定，但出院准备筛查显示助行器使用不安全、无确认居家支持、未转介居家护理、教育未完成、尚未评估楼梯能力，并且服用利伐沙班期间肌酐上升。为在患者回家前处理这些出院障碍，护士需要采取哪些措施？选择所有适用项。

stem.en: Postoperative day 2: The client's creatinine rose from 1.4 mg/dL to 1.5 mg/dL on postoperative day 1 and improved to 1.4 mg/dL after hydration. eGFR is 39 mL/min. The client is prescribed rivaroxaban 10 mg once daily for 35 days after hip arthroplasty. For each proposed nursing action, select whether it is appropriate or inappropriate.
stem.zh: 术后第2天：患者肌酐从1.4 mg/dL在术后第1天升至1.5 mg/dL，补液后改善至1.4 mg/dL。eGFR为39 mL/min。患者医嘱为髋关节置换术后利伐沙班10 mg每日一次，共35天。请判断每项拟采取的护理措施是适当还是不适当。

stem.en: Postoperative day 2: Interpreter-supported teach-back is successful, but the client states she cannot independently navigate the surgeon's English-language phone system. Which actions should the nurse include in the discharge plan? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 术后第2天：在解释员支持下回教成功，但患者表示无法独自应对外科医生办公室的英文电话系统。护士应在出院计划中纳入哪些措施？选择所有适用项。

stem.en: Postoperative day 3: The nurse is giving a verbal SBAR handoff to the receiving home health nurse. Which information is essential to include? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 术后第3天：护士正在向接收的居家护理护士进行SBAR口头交接。哪些信息必须纳入？选择所有适用项。

options.en: The client requires Mandarin interpretation for teaching and clinical communication.
options.zh: 患者在健康教育和临床沟通中需要普通话解释服务。

options.en: The client lives alone in a second-floor walk-up after the son leaves, and home safety/stair navigation need assessment.
options.zh: 儿子离开后患者独自住在二楼无电梯公寓，需要评估居家安全和上下楼梯。

options.en: Creatinine trended up transiently and returned to baseline; ongoing renal-function awareness is needed.
options.zh: 肌酐曾短暂升高后回到基础水平；仍需关注肾功能。

options.en: Equipment, functional status, follow-up appointment, and son's role as the phone contact have been confirmed.
options.zh: 设备、功能状态、随访预约以及儿子作为电话联系人的角色均已确认。

options.en: Rivaroxaban 10 mg daily is prescribed for 35 days; adherence and bleeding signs need monitoring.
options.zh: 医嘱为利伐沙班10 mg每日一次，共35天；需要监测依从性和出血征象。

options.en: The client preferred hot tea during hospitalization and declined the last two oxycodone doses.
options.zh: 患者住院期间偏好热茶，并拒绝了最近两次羟考酮。

correct.en: The handoff must transmit the risks that could cause transition failure: language needs, anticoagulant adherence and bleeding monitoring, renal-function context, social isolation and home layout, mobility/equipment needs, follow-up, and the designated communication contact. These data allow the home health nurse to continue the safety plan without information loss.
correct.zh: 交接必须传递可能导致转衔失败的风险：语言需求、抗凝药依从性和出血监测、肾功能背景、社会孤立和居家环境、活动/设备需求、随访以及指定沟通联系人。这些资料能让居家护理护士在不丢失信息的情况下延续安全计划。

byChoice.en: Correct. Language needs shape how all teaching, assessment, and symptom reporting must occur.
byChoice.zh: 正确。语言需求决定所有教育、评估和症状报告应如何进行。

byChoice.en: Correct. Equipment, function, follow-up, and phone-contact arrangements are all needed for continuity of the discharge plan.
byChoice.zh: 正确。设备、功能状态、随访和电话联系人安排都是延续出院计划所需的信息。

byChoice.en: Correct. Renal-function context matters because rivaroxaban has renal clearance and the client has baseline CKD.
byChoice.zh: 正确。因利伐沙班部分经肾脏清除且患者有基础CKD，肾功能背景很重要。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Declining oxycodone can support pain-control assessment, but tea preference is not essential transition-safety information; the option mixes a minor preference with a noncritical detail.
byChoice.zh: 错误。拒绝羟考酮可用于评估疼痛控制，但饮茶偏好不是关键转衔安全信息；该选项把次要偏好与非关键细节混在一起。

byChoice.en: Correct. Living alone in a walk-up apartment affects fall risk, access to care, and the home safety assessment.
byChoice.zh: 正确。独居在无电梯楼房会影响跌倒风险、获得照护能力和居家安全评估。

byChoice.en: Correct. Anticoagulant dose, duration, adherence, and bleeding surveillance are high-priority safety details.
byChoice.zh: 正确。抗凝药剂量、疗程、依从性和出血监测属于高优先级安全信息。

testTakingStrategy.en: For handoff items, choose information that changes the receiving clinician's monitoring, teaching, safety checks, or follow-up actions.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 交接题应选择会改变接收方临床人员监测、教育、安全检查或随访行动的信息。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看病历记录并回答案例分析题。

title.en: Clostridioides difficile infection with dehydration and contact-precaution teaching for family visitors.
title.zh: 艰难梭菌感染伴脱水以及家属探视的接触隔离宣教。

summary.en: A 71-year-old woman is transferred from a skilled nursing facility to a medical-surgical unit with a three-day history of profuse, watery, foul-smelling diarrhea. She completed a 10-day course of oral amoxicillin-clavulanate for community-acquired pneumonia six days ago. Her medical history includes type 2 diabetes managed with metformin 1,000 mg twice daily, hypertension treated with lisinopril 20 mg daily, osteoarthritis, and mild chronic kidney disease (baseline creatinine 1.4 mg/dL, baseline eGFR 42 mL/min/1.73 m²). She lives with her adult daughter and son-in-law, who visit daily and assist with meals and hygiene. On admission, the provider orders contact precautions, stool specimen for C. difficile toxin PCR, IV lactated Ringer's 500 mL bolus over 1 hour, then maintain at 125 mL/hr, strict intake and output, daily basic metabolic panel, and oral vancomycin 125 mg every 6 hours per facility protocol for suspected C. difficile infection. Metformin is held pending evaluation of renal function. A Braden scale assessment is ordered every shift.
summary.zh: 一名71岁女性患者因连续3天出现大量水样、恶臭腹泻，从专业护理机构转入内外科病房。她于6天前完成了为期10天的口服阿莫西林-克拉维酸治疗社区获得性肺炎的疗程。既往病史包括2型糖尿病（规律服用二甲双胍1000 mg，每日两次）、高血压（规律服用赖诺普利20 mg，每日一次）、骨关节炎以及轻度慢性肾脏病（基线肌酐1.4 mg/dL，基线eGFR 42 mL/min/1.73 m²）。她与成年的女儿和女婿同住，他们每天来探视并协助进食和个人卫生。入院时，考虑到疑似艰难梭菌感染，医生下达医嘱：接触隔离，留取粪便标本行艰难梭菌毒素PCR检测，静脉输注乳酸林格氏液 500 mL 负荷量（1小时内滴完），随后以 125 mL/hr 维持，严格记录出入量，每日复查基础代谢指标（BMP），并根据机构方案给予口服万古霉素125 mg，每6小时一次。二甲双胍暂停使用，待评估肾功能后决定。每班进行一次Braden量表评估。

content.en:
The patient reports six to eight loose, watery stools per day for the past three days, accompanied by diffuse crampy abdominal pain, poor oral intake, and increasing fatigue. She states she feels lightheaded when she stands and has not been eating well because "everything makes my stomach worse."

**Assessment Findings:** Temperature 100.6 °F (38.1 °C), heart rate 104, blood pressure 98/62, respiratory rate 18, SpO₂ 96% on room air. Weight 64 kg (documented weight two weeks ago was 68 kg). Mucous membranes dry and tacky, skin turgor sluggish over the sternum, capillary refill 3 seconds. Abdomen soft, diffusely tender without rebound or guarding; hyperactive bowel sounds. Perianal skin intact but erythematous. Braden score 15 (mild risk).

**Laboratory Data:** WBC 18.2 ×10³/µL, hemoglobin 13.8 g/dL, platelets 210 ×10³/µL. Sodium 139 mEq/L, potassium 3.3 mEq/L, chloride 96 mEq/L, bicarbonate 20 mEq/L, BUN 38 mg/dL, creatinine 2.1 mg/dL, eGFR 24 mL/min/1.73 m², glucose 188 mg/dL. Lactate 2.4 mmol/L. Albumin 2.8 g/dL. Stool C. difficile toxin PCR pending.
content.zh:
患者报告过去三天每天有6至8次稀水样便，伴有弥漫性痉挛性腹痛，进食差，疲劳感加重。她表示站立时感到头晕，并且因为“吃什么都让胃更难受”而没有好好进食。

**评估结果：** 体温 100.6 °F (38.1 °C)，心率 104，血压 98/62，呼吸频率 18，室内空气下SpO₂ 96%。体重 64 kg（两周前记录的体重为 68 kg）。黏膜干燥发粘，胸骨上方皮肤弹性迟缓，毛细血管充盈时间3秒。腹软，全腹弥漫性压痛，无反跳痛或肌紧张；肠鸣音活跃。肛周皮肤完整但有红斑。Braden量表评分 15分（轻度危险）。

**实验室数据：** WBC 18.2 ×10³/µL，血红蛋白 13.8 g/dL，血小板 210 ×10³/µL。钠 139 mEq/L，钾 3.3 mEq/L，氯 96 mEq/L，碳酸氢盐 20 mEq/L，BUN 38 mg/dL，肌酐 2.1 mg/dL，eGFR 24 mL/min/1.73 m²，葡萄糖 188 mg/dL。乳酸 2.4 mmol/L。白蛋白 2.8 g/dL。粪便艰难梭菌毒素PCR结果待报。

content.en:
The C. difficile toxin PCR returns positive. The patient has had four more watery stools since admission. Intake: 1,400 mL IV fluids; output: 200 mL urine plus an estimated 1,200 mL stool. She remains tachycardic (HR 100) and hypotensive (BP 100/64). Repeat potassium drawn at 6 hours is 3.1 mEq/L. The provider is notified and orders IV potassium chloride 10 mEq in 100 mL normal saline over 1 hour via peripheral IV, repeat once; recheck potassium after replacement.

The patient's daughter and son-in-law arrive for their evening visit. The nurse observes the daughter enter the room wearing gloves but no gown, and the son-in-law follows her in without any personal protective equipment. The son-in-law picks up the bedside TV remote and then touches the patient's hand.
content.zh:
艰难梭菌毒素PCR结果呈阳性。自入院以来，患者又排了四次水样便。入量：1400 mL静脉输液；出量：200 mL尿液加上估计 1200 mL的粪便。她仍然表现为心动过速（心率 100）和低血压（血压 100/64）。入院后6小时复查的血钾为 3.1 mEq/L。已通知医生，医嘱要求通过外周静脉在1小时内静脉输注10 mEq氯化钾加入100 mL生理盐水中，重复一次；补钾后复查血钾。

患者的女儿和女婿晚上来探视。护士观察到女儿戴着手套但未穿隔离衣进入病房，女婿紧随其后进入，未穿戴任何个人防护装备（PPE）。女婿拿起病床旁的电视遥控器，然后摸了摸患者的手。

content.en:
The patient's stool frequency has decreased to three episodes over the past 8 hours. Repeat labs: potassium 3.6 mEq/L (post-replacement), creatinine 1.9 mg/dL, BUN 34 mg/dL, lactate 1.8 mmol/L. Vitals: T 99.7 °F (37.6 °C), HR 92, BP 108/68, RR 16, SpO₂ 97%. Urine output over the past 8 hours is 280 mL. She is tolerating small sips of clear liquids.

The perianal erythema has worsened: the skin is now macerated with a shallow 1 cm × 0.5 cm area of partial-thickness skin loss at the 6-o'clock position. The Braden moisture subscale has dropped to 1 (constantly moist).

The daughter asks the nurse, "Can I just use hand sanitizer instead of washing my hands every time? It's faster." She also asks whether she needs to wear a gown and gloves when she is "just sitting in the chair and not touching Mom."
content.zh:
在过去的8小时内，患者的排便频率已降至三次。复查实验室指标：钾 3.6 mEq/L（补钾后），肌酐 1.9 mg/dL，BUN 34 mg/dL，乳酸 1.8 mmol/L。生命体征：体温 99.7 °F (37.6 °C)，心率 92，血压 108/68，呼吸 16，SpO₂ 97%。过去8小时的尿量为 280 mL。她能够耐受小口啜饮清流质饮食。

肛周红斑恶化：皮肤现在出现浸渍，在6点钟位置有一个 1 cm × 0.5 cm 的浅表部分皮层缺失区域。Braden量表的潮湿子项评分已降至1分（持续潮湿）。

女儿问护士：“我可以只用免洗手消液而不是每次都洗手吗？那样比较快。”她还问，如果她“只是坐在椅子上，不接触妈妈”，是否还需要穿隔离衣和戴手套。

content.en:
Stool frequency is down to two formed-to-semiformed stools in the past 12 hours. Repeat labs: potassium 3.8 mEq/L, creatinine 1.6 mg/dL, BUN 28 mg/dL, eGFR 33 mL/min/1.73 m², lactate 1.2 mmol/L, WBC 12.4 ×10³/µL. Vitals: T 99 °F (37.2 °C), HR 82, BP 118/72, RR 16, SpO₂ 98%. Urine output over the past 8 hours is 400 mL (50 mL/hr). The patient is eating a soft diet and drinking fluids independently.

The perianal wound has a clean base with no extension; a moisture barrier cream was applied at Stage 2 and the surrounding maceration is improving. The provider asks the nurse to evaluate readiness for transition back to oral medications and to assess whether metformin can be restarted.

The daughter demonstrates correct donning and doffing of gown and gloves and performs hand hygiene with soap and water before and after the visit without prompting.
content.zh:
在过去的12小时内，排便频率已降至两次成形至半成形便。复查实验室指标：钾 3.8 mEq/L，肌酐 1.6 mg/dL，BUN 28 mg/dL，eGFR 33 mL/min/1.73 m²，乳酸 1.2 mmol/L，WBC 12.4 ×10³/µL。生命体征：体温 99 °F (37.2 °C)，心率 82，血压 118/72，呼吸 16，SpO₂ 98%。过去8小时的尿量为 400 mL（50 mL/hr）。患者正在吃软食并自主饮水。

肛周伤口基底干净，未见扩大；在阶段2应用了防潮隔离霜，周围的浸渍情况正在改善。医生要求护士评估是否已准备好过渡回口服药物，并评估是否可以重新开始使用二甲双胍。

女儿正确地演示了穿脱隔离衣和手套，并在探视前后主动用肥皂和水进行了手卫生。

stem.en: Based on the assessment findings and laboratory data at Stage 1, which physiological condition poses the most immediate threat to the patient?
stem.zh: 根据阶段1的评估结果和实验室数据，哪种生理状况对患者构成了最直接的威胁？

stem.en: At Stage 1, the nurse observes the daughter entering the room in gloves but no gown, and the son-in-law entering without any personal protective equipment. Which action should the nurse take immediately?
stem.zh: 在阶段1，护士观察到女儿戴着手套但未穿隔离衣进入病房，女婿未穿戴任何个人防护装备进入病房。护士应立即采取哪项行动？

stem.en: At Stage 2, the daughter asks the nurse if she can use hand sanitizer instead of washing her hands, and whether she needs to wear a gown and gloves if she is 'just sitting in the chair.' How should the nurse respond?
stem.zh: 在阶段2，女儿问护士是否可以使用免洗手消液代替洗手，以及如果她“只是坐在椅子上”，是否还需要穿隔离衣和戴手套。护士应如何回答？

stem.en: At Stage 2, the nurse assesses worsening perianal skin maceration and partial-thickness skin loss. Which intervention is the priority for protecting the patient's skin integrity?
stem.zh: 在阶段2，护士评估发现肛周皮肤浸渍加重并出现部分皮层缺失。为了保护患者的皮肤完整性，哪项干预措施是优先考虑的？

stem.en: At Stage 3, the provider asks the nurse to evaluate whether the patient's home metformin should be restarted. The patient's eGFR is now 33 mL/min/1.73 m² (baseline 42). Which response by the nurse is the most appropriate?
stem.zh: 在阶段3，医生要求护士评估是否应重新开始使用患者居家服用的二甲双胍。患者目前的eGFR为 33 mL/min/1.73 m²（基线为42）。护士最恰当的回答是哪一项？

options.en: "Yes, we should resume it at the previous dose since the eGFR is trending upward."
options.zh: “是的，我们应该以先前的剂量恢复使用，因为eGFR呈现上升趋势。”

options.en: "I recommend holding it for now because the eGFR has not yet returned to her baseline and remains in a caution range."
options.zh: “我建议暂时停用，因为eGFR尚未恢复到她的基线水平，并且仍处于需要谨慎使用的范围内。”

options.en: "We can restart it, but we need to monitor her blood glucose closely for signs of hypoglycemia."
options.zh: “我们可以重新开始使用，但我们需要密切监测她的血糖，注意低血糖的迹象。”

options.en: "Metformin is permanently contraindicated now because her eGFR is below 45 mL/min/1.73 m²."
options.zh: “现在二甲双胍是永久禁忌的，因为她的eGFR低于 45 mL/min/1.73 m²。”

correct.en: Metformin carries a risk of lactic acidosis that increases with renal impairment. Although the eGFR has improved from 24 to 33 mL/min/1.73 m², it has not returned to her baseline of 42. Furthermore, an eGFR of 30-45 represents a caution range where dosage adjustment and close monitoring are required if initiated or continued. Restarting the medication while the patient is still recovering from acute kidney injury and dehydration is unsafe.
correct.zh: 二甲双胍具有引起乳酸酸中毒的风险，该风险随肾功能损害而增加。虽然eGFR已从24改善至 33 mL/min/1.73 m²，但尚未恢复到其基线水平42。此外，eGFR 30-45属于需要谨慎使用的范围，如果在该范围内开始或继续使用，需要调整剂量并密切监测。在患者仍从急性肾损伤和脱水中恢复时重新开始使用该药物是不安全的。

byChoice.en: An upward trend is positive, but the absolute value (33) and the failure to return to baseline indicate that renal function has not adequately recovered to safely clear full-dose metformin.
byChoice.zh: 上升趋势是积极的，但绝对值（33）以及未能恢复到基线表明，肾功能尚未充分恢复以安全清除全剂量的二甲双胍。

byChoice.en: Correct. Holding the medication is the safest approach until renal function approaches baseline and the patient is hemodynamically stable.
byChoice.zh: 正确。在肾功能接近基线且患者血流动力学稳定之前，暂停使用该药物是最安全的做法。

byChoice.en: The primary concern with metformin and renal impairment is lactic acidosis, not hypoglycemia. Restarting it at this point is inappropriate.
byChoice.zh: 二甲双胍和肾功能损害的主要问题是乳酸酸中毒，而不是低血糖。此时重新开始使用是不合适的。

byChoice.en: Metformin is generally contraindicated when eGFR is below 30 mL/min/1.73 m². At 30-45, it is not an absolute contraindication but requires dose review and caution.
byChoice.zh: 当eGFR低于 30 mL/min/1.73 m² 时，二甲双胍通常是禁忌使用的。在30-45之间，它不是绝对禁忌，但需要复核剂量并谨慎使用。

testTakingStrategy.en: Metformin and kidney disease: remember that poor renal function (especially eGFR < 30) increases the risk of lactic acidosis. Wait for renal recovery before resuming.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 二甲双胍与肾脏疾病：记住，不良的肾功能（特别是 eGFR < 30）会增加乳酸酸中毒的风险。在恢复肾功能之前应等待。

stem.en: At Stage 3, the nurse synthesizes the patient's data to evaluate the response to treatment. For each finding, determine if it indicates clinical improvement or requires ongoing monitoring.
stem.zh: 在阶段3，护士综合患者的数据以评估治疗反应。对于每一项发现，请判断它是否表明临床病情改善，或者是否需要持续监测。

rows.en: Stool frequency of two formed-to-semiformed stools in 12 hours
rows.zh: 12小时内排便两次，为成形至半成形便

rows.en: White blood cell (WBC) count decreasing from 18.2 ×10³/µL to 12.4 ×10³/µL
rows.zh: 白细胞 (WBC) 计数从 18.2 ×10³/µL 降至 12.4 ×10³/µL
eGFR 为 33 mL/min/1.73 m²（基线为 42）

correct.en: Decreased stool frequency, a dropping WBC count, restoring urine output, and a normal lactate level all indicate clinical improvement and positive response to treatment. However, an eGFR of 33 mL/min/1.73 m² remains below the patient's baseline of 42, indicating residual renal impairment that requires ongoing monitoring.
correct.zh: 排便频率降低、白细胞计数下降、尿量恢复以及乳酸水平正常均表明临床病情改善且对治疗有积极反应。然而，eGFR 为 33 mL/min/1.73 m² 仍低于患者的基线 42，表明存在残留的肾功能损害，需要持续监测。

byChoice.en: Decreased frequency and firmer consistency directly indicate the primary infection is resolving.
byChoice.zh: 频率降低和性状变硬直接表明原发感染正在消退。

byChoice.en: Although still mildly elevated, the downward trend from 18,200/µL is a clear sign of improvement.
byChoice.zh: 尽管仍有轻度升高，但从 18,200/µL 开始的下降趋势是明显的改善迹象。

byChoice.en: Renal function has not adequately recovered to baseline; this deficit requires ongoing monitoring before therapies like metformin can be safely resumed.
byChoice.zh: 肾功能尚未充分恢复至基线水平；在安全恢复二甲双胍等治疗之前，这种功能缺陷需要持续监测。

byChoice.en: Urine output >30 mL/hr confirms that renal perfusion has been restored.
byChoice.zh: 尿量 >30 mL/hr 证实肾灌注已恢复。

byChoice.en: Lactate dropping into the normal range indicates improved systemic tissue perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 乳酸降至正常范围表明全身组织灌注改善。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate outcomes by looking at the trend, not just the absolute number. A WBC dropping from 18,200 to 12,400 is an improving trend, even if it has not yet reached the normal range (<10,000).
testTakingStrategy.zh: 通过观察趋势而不仅仅是绝对数值来评估结果。即使尚未达到正常范围（<10,000），WBC 从 18,200 降至 12,400 也是一种改善的趋势。

stem.en: Review the client record for a client receiving vancomycin for MRSA bacteremia and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 查看一名因 MRSA 菌血症接受万古霉素治疗的患者记录，并回答案例题。

title.en: Unfolding case: vancomycin infusion reaction and nephrotoxicity
title.zh: 展开式案例：万古霉素输注反应与肾毒性

summary.en: A 67-year-old man with MRSA bacteremia, stage 3b chronic kidney disease, diabetes, hypertension treated with lisinopril and carvedilol, and baseline bilateral sensorineural hearing loss begins pharmacy-guided vancomycin therapy.
summary.zh: 一名 67 岁男性因 MRSA 菌血症开始由药师指导的万古霉素治疗；既往有 3b 期慢性肾病、糖尿病、使用赖诺普利和卡维地洛治疗的高血压，以及基线双侧感音神经性听力下降。

content.en:
Age: 67 years. Admitted from the emergency department with two blood-culture sets showing gram-positive cocci in clusters with preliminary MRSA identification. Suspected source: infected left forearm arteriovenous fistula with erythema, warmth, induration, tenderness, and purulent drainage.
History: stage 3b chronic kidney disease; baseline creatinine 1.6 mg/dL; estimated baseline creatinine clearance 44 mL/min; type 2 diabetes; hypertension; obesity; bilateral sensorineural hearing loss managed with hearing aids. No documented drug allergies.
Orders: vancomycin 2,000 mg IV loading dose over at least 2 hours, then 1,250 mg IV every 12 hours; vancomycin trough before the fourth maintenance dose; normal saline 75 mL/hr; strict intake and output; daily basic metabolic panel; repeat blood cultures in 48 hours; transthoracic echocardiogram; vascular surgery consult. Home medications continued, including lisinopril 10 mg daily and carvedilol 12.5 mg twice daily. No premedication is ordered before the first vancomycin dose.
content.zh:
年龄：67 岁。患者从急诊收入院，两组血培养显示成簇革兰阳性球菌，初步鉴定为 MRSA。疑似来源：左前臂动静脉瘘感染，局部发红、发热、硬结、压痛，并有脓性引流。
病史：3b 期慢性肾病；基线肌酐 1.6 mg/dL；估算基线肌酐清除率 44 mL/min；2 型糖尿病；高血压；肥胖；双侧感音神经性听力下降，使用助听器。无已记录药物过敏。
医嘱：万古霉素 2,000 mg IV 负荷剂量，至少输注 2 小时；随后 1,250 mg IV 每 12 小时一次；第 4 次维持剂量前抽万古霉素谷浓度；0.9% 氯化钠 75 mL/小时；严格记录出入量；每日基础代谢面板；48 小时后复查血培养；经胸超声心动图；血管外科会诊。继续家庭用药，包括赖诺普利 10 mg 每日一次和卡维地洛 12.5 mg 每日两次。首次万古霉素前未开具预处理用药。

title.en: 1400 baseline assessment and ED laboratory results
title.zh: 1400 基线评估与急诊实验室结果

content.en:
Vital signs: temperature 101.5 °F (38.6 °C), heart rate 96/min regular, blood pressure 142/84 mm Hg, respiratory rate 18/min, SpO2 96% on room air.
Assessment: alert and oriented; no rash, flushing, urticaria, or angioedema; lungs clear; chronic 1+ bilateral lower-extremity edema; right antecubital 18-gauge peripheral IV flushes easily. Hearing is functional with hearing aids in place.
Labs drawn at 1200: WBC 14.8 ×10³/µL with 82% neutrophils and 9% bands; hemoglobin 11.2 g/dL; platelets 228 ×10³/µL; sodium 138 mEq/L; potassium 4.6 mEq/L; bicarbonate 22 mEq/L; BUN 32 mg/dL; creatinine 1.8 mg/dL; eGFR 38 mL/min; glucose 198 mg/dL; lactate 2.2 mmol/L; albumin 2.8 g/dL. Urinalysis: trace protein, no casts, no bacteria.
content.zh:
生命体征：体温 101.5 °F (38.6 °C)，心率 96 次/分且规则，血压 142/84 mm Hg，呼吸 18 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 96%。
评估：神志清楚并定向力完整；无皮疹、潮红、荨麻疹或血管性水肿；双肺清；双下肢慢性 1+ 水肿；右肘前 18G 外周静脉针冲管通畅。佩戴助听器时听力可满足交流。
1200 抽血结果：WBC 14.8 ×10³/µL，中性粒细胞 82%，杆状核 9%；血红蛋白 11.2 g/dL；血小板 228 ×10³/µL；钠 138 mEq/L；钾 4.6 mEq/L；碳酸氢根 22 mEq/L；BUN 32 mg/dL；肌酐 1.8 mg/dL；eGFR 38 mL/min；血糖 198 mg/dL；乳酸 2.2 mmol/L；白蛋白 2.8 g/dL。尿液分析：微量蛋白，无管型，无细菌。

title.zh: 万古霉素开始后 15 分钟

content.en:
The 2,000 mg loading dose was started at 1430 by infusion pump to run over 120 minutes. At 1445, the client reports sudden intense itching of the face, neck, and upper chest and says his skin feels like it is burning. He denies shortness of breath, throat tightness, tongue swelling, or difficulty swallowing.
Assessment: face, neck, and upper trunk are diffusely flushed with a clear lower boundary near the nipple line; lower trunk and extremities are unaffected. Scattered raised, pruritic, blanchable wheals are present across the anterior chest. No stridor, wheezing, lip or tongue angioedema, or urticaria below the waist. He is anxious but alert and breathing comfortably.
Vital signs: heart rate 118/min, blood pressure 108/62 mm Hg, respiratory rate 20/min, SpO2 96% on room air.
content.zh:
2,000 mg 负荷剂量于 1430 用输液泵开始，计划 120 分钟输完。1445，患者诉面部、颈部和上胸部突然剧烈瘙痒，并说皮肤像在烧。他否认气短、喉咙发紧、舌肿或吞咽困难。
评估：面部、颈部和上半身弥漫性潮红，下界清楚，约在乳头线附近；下半身和四肢未受影响。前胸可见散在隆起、瘙痒、按压可褪色的风团。无喘鸣、哮鸣、唇舌血管性水肿或腰以下荨麻疹。患者焦虑但清醒，呼吸舒适。
生命体征：心率 118 次/分，血压 108/62 mm Hg，呼吸 20 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 96%。

title.zh: 阶段 1 干预后的反应

content.en: The infusion is stopped, the IV is kept patent with normal saline, the client is positioned supine with legs slightly elevated, vital signs are repeated, and the provider is notified. Diphenhydramine 25 mg IV and acetaminophen 650 mg PO are administered as ordered. Symptoms improve after 30 minutes. The provider orders vancomycin to restart at half the original rate. The remaining dose completes without recurrent symptoms. The event is documented as an infusion-related adverse drug reaction rather than a drug allergy.
content.zh: 停止输注，用生理盐水保持静脉通路通畅，使患者仰卧并轻度抬高双腿，复测生命体征，并通知医嘱者。按医嘱给予苯海拉明 25 mg IV 和对乙酰氨基酚 650 mg PO。30 分钟后症状改善。医嘱者要求以原速度一半重新开始万古霉素。剩余剂量完成后未再出现症状。该事件记录为输注相关不良药物反应，而不是药物过敏。

title.en: Stage 2: hospital day 3 trough and monitoring
title.zh: 阶段 2：住院第 3 天谷浓度与监测

content.en:
The client has received three maintenance doses of vancomycin 1,250 mg IV every 12 hours without recurrent flushing; each dose was premedicated with diphenhydramine and infused over at least 2 hours. The trough drawn at 0730 before the fourth maintenance dose returns at 0830: 22.4 mcg/mL. Institutional trough-surrogate protocol flags this as supratherapeutic.
Pharmacist recommendation being communicated to the infectious disease provider: reduce vancomycin to 1,000 mg IV every 12 hours, recheck the trough before the third dose on the new regimen, and increase monitoring for nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity.
Morning labs: WBC 12.2 ×10³/µL, creatinine 1.7 mg/dL, BUN 28 mg/dL, potassium 4.4 mEq/L, lactate 1.4 mmol/L, glucose 164 mg/dL. Urine output previous 24 hours: 1,440 mL.
content.zh:
患者已接受三次万古霉素维持剂量 1,250 mg IV 每 12 小时一次，未再出现潮红；每次均先给予苯海拉明预处理，并至少输注 2 小时。0730 于第 4 次维持剂量前抽取的谷浓度在 0830 返回：22.4 mcg/mL。机构谷浓度替代方案将其标记为超治疗范围。
药师正向感染科医嘱者传达建议：将万古霉素减量为 1,000 mg IV 每 12 小时一次，在新方案第 3 次剂量前复查谷浓度，并加强肾毒性和耳毒性监测。
晨间化验：WBC 12.2 ×10³/µL，肌酐 1.7 mg/dL，BUN 28 mg/dL，钾 4.4 mEq/L，乳酸 1.4 mmol/L，血糖 164 mg/dL。过去 24 小时尿量：1,440 mL。

title.en: Stage 3: hospital day 4 kidney injury and tinnitus
title.zh: 阶段 3：住院第 4 天肾损伤与耳鸣

content.en:
The client has received vancomycin 1,000 mg IV every 12 hours since the dose adjustment. Current trough: 18.6 mcg/mL, within the institutional surrogate target range.
Vital signs: temperature 99.3 °F (37.4 °C), heart rate 82/min, blood pressure 148/88 mm Hg, respiratory rate 18/min, SpO2 96% on room air.
Morning labs: creatinine 2.4 mg/dL, BUN 44 mg/dL, potassium 5.1 mEq/L, bicarbonate 19 mEq/L, eGFR 26 mL/min. Overnight urine output: 180 mL in 12 hours. Urine is dark amber and concentrated.
The client reports new persistent bilateral ringing in the ears that began overnight. Repeat blood cultures from day 2 show no growth at 48 hours; echocardiogram shows no vegetations; AV fistula erythema and drainage are improving. Lower-extremity edema is now 2+ bilaterally.
content.zh:
自减量后，患者一直接受万古霉素 1,000 mg IV 每 12 小时一次。当前谷浓度：18.6 mcg/mL，在机构替代目标范围内。
生命体征：体温 99.3 °F (37.4 °C)，心率 82 次/分，血压 148/88 mm Hg，呼吸 18 次/分，室内空气 SpO2 96%。
晨间化验：肌酐 2.4 mg/dL，BUN 44 mg/dL，钾 5.1 mEq/L，碳酸氢根 19 mEq/L，eGFR 26 mL/min。夜间尿量：12 小时 180 mL。尿液呈深琥珀色且浓缩。
患者报告夜间开始出现新的持续性双侧耳鸣。第 2 天复查血培养 48 小时无生长；超声心动图无赘生物；动静脉瘘红斑和引流改善。双下肢水肿现在为 2+。

content.en: The infectious disease provider orders: hold vancomycin; obtain a stat vancomycin level; switch to renally dosed daptomycin 6 mg/kg IV every 48 hours; hold lisinopril; obtain a renal ultrasound; request nephrology consult. The stat vancomycin level later returns at 24.1 mcg/mL.
content.zh: 感染科医嘱者下达医嘱：暂停万古霉素；立即抽取万古霉素水平；改用按肾功能调整剂量的达托霉素 6 mg/kg IV 每 48 小时一次；暂停赖诺普利；做肾脏超声；请肾内科会诊。之后立即抽取的万古霉素水平返回为 24.1 mcg/mL。

stem.en: Stage 1: Fifteen minutes after the vancomycin loading dose begins, the client develops intense itching, flushing limited to the face/neck/upper trunk, chest wheals, tachycardia, and mild hypotension. He has no wheezing, stridor, tongue swelling, throat tightness, or generalized urticaria. Which action should the nurse take first?
stem.zh: 阶段 1：万古霉素负荷剂量开始 15 分钟后，患者出现剧烈瘙痒，潮红局限于面部、颈部和上半身，胸前有风团，心动过速并轻度低血压。无哮鸣、喘鸣、舌肿、喉咙发紧或全身性荨麻疹。护士首先应采取哪项措施？

stem.en: Stage 1: The flushing and itching resolve after the infusion is stopped and diphenhydramine is administered. The provider restarts the remaining dose at a slower rate without recurrence of symptoms. Complete the nursing documentation and handoff statement.
stem.zh: 阶段 1：停止输注并给予苯海拉明后，潮红和瘙痒缓解。医嘱者以较慢速度重新开始剩余剂量，症状未复发。完成护士记录和交接说明。

stem.en: Stage 2: The pharmacist recommends increased ototoxicity monitoring. The client has baseline bilateral hearing loss and uses hearing aids. Which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 阶段 2：药师建议加强耳毒性监测。患者基线已有双侧听力下降，并使用助听器。哪些护理措施合适？选择所有适用项。

stem.en: Stage 3: Classify each finding based on how it should affect the nurse's interpretation of the scheduled 0800 vancomycin dose.
stem.zh: 阶段 3：根据每项发现对护士解读 0800 预定万古霉素剂量安全性的影响进行分类。

stem.en: Stage 3: Vancomycin has been held and the antibiotic plan is being changed because of acute kidney injury and new tinnitus. The nurse reviews the medication administration record and sees that lisinopril 10 mg daily is still active and the morning dose has not been given. Potassium is 5.1 mEq/L. What should the nurse do?
stem.zh: 阶段 3：因急性肾损伤和新的耳鸣，万古霉素已被暂停，抗生素方案正在更改。护士查看给药记录，发现赖诺普利 10 mg 每日一次仍为有效医嘱，晨间剂量尚未给予。钾为 5.1 mEq/L。护士应怎么做？

stem.en: Stage 2: The vancomycin trough returns at 22.4 mcg/mL 30 minutes before the next scheduled 1,250 mg dose. The pharmacist recommends a dose reduction and is contacting the infectious disease provider. Arrange the nurse's actions in the safest order.
stem.zh: 阶段 2：下一次预定 1,250 mg 剂量前 30 分钟，万古霉素谷浓度返回为 22.4 mcg/mL。药师建议减量，并正在联系感染科医嘱者。请按最安全顺序排列护士的行动。

options.en: Document the trough, held dose, notifications, verified new order, and monitoring plan.
options.zh: 记录谷浓度、暂缓给药、通知情况、已核实的新医嘱以及监测计划。

options.en: Hold the scheduled 1,250 mg vancomycin dose while the order is being clarified.
options.zh: 在澄清医嘱期间，暂缓预定的 1,250 mg 万古霉素剂量。

options.en: Contact the prescriber to confirm the revised dosing order recommended by pharmacy.
options.zh: 联系医嘱者，确认药师建议的修订剂量医嘱。

options.en: Administer the revised dose using the ordered premedication and slower infusion precautions.
options.zh: 按已下达的预处理和较慢输注预防措施，给予修订后的剂量。

options.en: Verify that the new 1,000 mg vancomycin order is active in the medication administration record.
options.zh: 核实新的 1,000 mg 万古霉素医嘱已在给药记录中生效。

correct.en: A supratherapeutic trough in a client with impaired renal clearance makes the current scheduled dose unsafe to administer without clarification. The nurse should hold the dose, obtain the revised provider order, verify it in the MAR, administer only the corrected regimen with the ordered precautions, and document the safety actions and monitoring plan.
correct.zh: 肾清除功能受损的患者出现超治疗范围谷浓度时，若不澄清医嘱，当前预定剂量不安全。护士应暂缓给药，取得医嘱者修订医嘱，在给药记录中核实后，仅按纠正后的方案和已下达预防措施给药，并记录安全行动和监测计划。

byChoice.en: After the corrected order is active, the revised dose may be given with the prior flushing precautions.
byChoice.zh: 纠正后的医嘱生效后，可结合既往潮红反应的预防措施给予修订剂量。

byChoice.en: Holding first prevents avoidable accumulation while the unsafe current order is being revised.
byChoice.zh: 首先暂缓给药可在不安全的现有医嘱被修订期间避免药物继续蓄积。

byChoice.en: Verification in the MAR prevents administering from an old or unentered order.
byChoice.zh: 在给药记录中核实可防止按旧医嘱或未录入医嘱给药。

byChoice.en: The nurse must obtain prescriber clarification rather than independently changing the dose.
byChoice.zh: 护士必须取得医嘱者澄清，而不是自行改变剂量。

byChoice.en: Documentation follows the clinical actions and creates a clear record of the abnormal level, hold, communication, and follow-up monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 记录应在临床行动之后进行，清楚说明异常浓度、暂缓给药、沟通和后续监测。

testTakingStrategy.en: For ordered-response medication safety items, protect the client first, then clarify the order, verify the corrected order, administer only when safe, and document after action is taken.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 药物安全排序题中，先保护患者，再澄清医嘱，核实纠正后的医嘱，确认安全后才给药，最后记录已采取的行动。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 查阅患者病历并回答病例研究问题。

title.en: Warfarin initiation with enoxaparin bridge therapy at discharge following acute deep vein thrombosis.
title.zh: 急性深静脉血栓形成后出院时依诺肝素桥接治疗联合华法林初始治疗。

summary.en: A 63-year-old man is being prepared for discharge from a medical-surgical unit after a five-day hospitalization for an acute left lower-extremity proximal deep vein thrombosis (DVT) extending from the popliteal to the common femoral vein, confirmed by duplex ultrasonography on admission day. His medical history includes obesity (BMI 34), type 2 diabetes managed with metformin 1,000 mg twice daily, hypertension treated with amlodipine 10 mg daily, and osteoarthritis for which he has been taking over-the-counter ibuprofen 400 mg as needed, typically three to four times per week. He has no history of prior venous thromboembolism, no known bleeding disorders, and no prior exposure to anticoagulants. He lives with his wife, manages his own medications, and works as a long-haul truck driver. He was started on a therapeutic enoxaparin dose of 1 mg/kg subcutaneously every 12 hours on admission day, and warfarin 5 mg daily was initiated on the evening of hospital day 2. His renal function is normal (eGFR 88 mL/min/1.73 m²). The facility's specific discharge protocol calls for continuing the enoxaparin bridge at home until the INR is therapeutic (2.0–3.0) on two consecutive measurements at least 24 hours apart, which is stricter than the standard minimum of five days of overlap with an INR ≥2.0 for at least 24 hours.
summary.zh: 一名63岁男性患者在内外科病房住院5天后准备出院。他因左下肢近端急性深静脉血栓形成（DVT）（从腘静脉延伸至股总静脉）入院，入院当天通过多普勒超声确认。他的病史包括肥胖（BMI 34）、服用二甲双胍1000 mg，每日两次控制的2型糖尿病、服用氨氯地平10 mg，每日一次控制的高血压，以及骨关节炎，为此他按需服用非处方布洛芬400 mg，通常每周3至4次。他没有既往静脉血栓栓塞史，没有已知的出血性疾病，既往未曾使用过抗凝剂。他与妻子同住，自己管理药物，是一名长途卡车司机。入院当天他开始接受治疗剂量的依诺肝素，1 mg/kg，皮下注射，每12小时一次，并在住院第2天晚上开始每天服用华法林5 mg。他的肾功能正常（eGFR 88 mL/min/1.73 m²）。该机构的具体出院方案要求在家中继续依诺肝素桥接治疗，直到至少相隔24小时的连续两次测量中INR达到治疗范围（2.0-3.0），这比依诺肝素和华法林至少重叠五天且INR≥2.0至少24小时的标准下限更为严格。

title.zh: 评估与实验室检查（基线 - 住院第5天上午）

content.en:
ASSESSMENT FINDINGS:
T 98.4 °F (36.9 °C), HR 74, BP 134/78, RR 14, SpO₂ 97% on room air. Alert, oriented, in no acute distress. Left lower extremity: mild residual edema from mid-calf to ankle, no erythema or warmth, pedal pulse palpable, sensation intact, compression stocking in place. No bruising at enoxaparin injection sites (bilateral abdomen). No petechiae, no gum bleeding, no melena reported. Ambulating independently with mild discomfort in the left calf.

LABORATORY DATA:
Hospital day 2 (warfarin start): INR 1.0, aPTT 29 sec, platelets 212 ×10³/µL, Hgb 14.8 g/dL, creatinine 1.0 mg/dL.
Hospital day 4: INR 1.6, platelets 198 ×10³/µL, Hgb 14.5 g/dL.
Hospital day 5 (morning of planned discharge): INR 1.9, platelets 195 ×10³/µL, Hgb 14.3 g/dL.
content.zh:
评估发现：
体温 98.4 °F (36.9 °C)，心率 74 次/分，血压 134/78 mmHg，呼吸 14 次/分，室内空气下 SpO₂ 97%。神志清醒，定向力正常，无急性痛苦面容。左下肢：小腿中段至脚踝有轻度残余水肿，无红斑或发热，足背动脉搏动可触及，感觉完整，已穿戴弹力袜。依诺肝素注射部位（双侧腹部）无瘀伤。无瘀点，无牙龈出血，未报告黑便。能独立行走，左小腿轻度不适。

实验室数据：
住院第2天（开始服用华法林）：INR 1.0，aPTT 29 秒，血小板 212 ×10³/µL，血红蛋白 14.8 g/dL，肌酐 1.0 mg/dL。
住院第4天：INR 1.6，血小板 198 ×10³/µL，血红蛋白 14.5 g/dL。
住院第5天（计划出院当天上午）：INR 1.9，血小板 195 ×10³/µL，血红蛋白 14.3 g/dL。

content.en: The INR result of 1.9 returns while the nurse is reviewing the discharge medication list with the patient and his wife. The patient's wife asks, "The doctor said his blood needs to be between 2 and 3. It's 1.9 — is that close enough to stop the shots?" The patient adds that he took two ibuprofen tablets this morning for knee pain and asks whether he can keep taking ibuprofen at home since "it's just over the counter." The discharge medication reconciliation list generated by pharmacy includes warfarin 5 mg daily, enoxaparin 1 mg/kg every 12 hours, metformin 1,000 mg twice daily, amlodipine 10 mg daily, and ibuprofen 400 mg as needed. The patient also mentions that his wife has been reading online and bought a large bag of frozen spinach and kale to "build his blood back up" because she heard he might be anemic from the blood thinner.
content.zh: 当护士正与患者及其妻子核对出院药物清单时，回报了INR结果为1.9。患者妻子问：“医生说他的血需要在2到3之间。现在是1.9——这够接近以停止打针了吗？”患者补充说，他今天早上因为膝盖疼痛吃了两片布洛芬，并问回家后是否可以继续服用布洛芬，因为“这只是非处方药”。药房生成的出院药物核对表包括每天5 mg华法林、每12小时1 mg/kg依诺肝素、每天两次1,000 mg二甲双胍、每天10 mg氨氯地平，以及按需400 mg布洛芬。患者还提到，他妻子在网上查过资料，买了一大袋冷冻菠菜和羽衣甘蓝来“给他补血”，因为她听说他可能会因为服用血液稀释剂而贫血。

content.en: The nurse has notified the provider about the ibuprofen on the medication reconciliation list and the patient's reported use this morning. The provider discontinues ibuprofen and writes for acetaminophen 650 mg every 6 hours as needed for pain, maximum 3 grams per day given the patient's age. The provider confirms that the INR of 1.9 does not meet the therapeutic threshold and that the enoxaparin bridge must continue at home; warfarin will continue at 5 mg daily, and the first outpatient INR is ordered for two days post-discharge at the anticoagulation clinic. During the teaching session, the patient asks how to give himself the enoxaparin injections at home — he has watched the nurses do it but has never self-administered. His wife volunteers to give the injections. The nurse begins a return demonstration. During the demonstration, the wife pinches a skin fold on the patient's abdomen and prepares to aspirate before injecting. The patient asks, "How will I know if something is going wrong with the blood thinner — like if I'm bleeding inside?"
content.zh: 护士已向医生报告了药物核对清单上的布洛芬以及患者今早报告的服用情况。医生停用了布洛芬，并开出对乙酰氨基酚 650 mg 每 6 小时按需止痛，考虑到患者的年龄，每天最多 3 克。医生确认 INR 为 1.9 未达到治疗阈值，必须在家中继续依诺肝素桥接治疗；华法林将继续每天 5 mg，首次门诊 INR 检查安排在出院后两天在抗凝诊所进行。在教学环节中，患者询问如何在家中自己注射依诺肝素——他看过护士注射，但从未自己操作过。他的妻子自告奋勇进行注射。护士开始进行回示教。在示教过程中，妻子捏起患者腹部的一块皮肤皱褶，并准备在注射前回抽。患者问：“如果血液稀释剂出了问题——比如我在内出血，我怎么会知道？”

content.en: The patient has successfully demonstrated subcutaneous injection technique with his wife. The nurse is completing the final discharge review. The patient mentions that he is scheduled to return to work driving his truck in four days and asks whether that is safe. He also asks whether he should "eat a lot of green vegetables to stay healthy" or avoid them. His wife pulls out a printed list of "foods to avoid on warfarin" she found online, which includes all leafy greens, broccoli, green tea, avocado, and soy products, and says, "I guess we just cut all of these out." The patient's final set of vitals before discharge: T 98.6 °F (37.0 °C), HR 72, BP 130/76, RR 14, SpO₂ 98%. No new bruising. Left leg edema unchanged. The anticoagulation clinic appointment is confirmed for two days post-discharge, and the patient has a printed appointment card. The nurse reviews the signs and symptoms requiring emergency care versus same-day anticoagulation clinic contact.
content.zh: 患者已成功与妻子进行了皮下注射技术的回示教。护士正在完成最后的出院检查。患者提到他计划在四天后重返工作岗位驾驶卡车，并询问这是否安全。他还问是否应该“吃很多绿色蔬菜来保持健康”还是避免吃。他的妻子拿出一份从网上打印的“服用华法林应避免的食物”清单，其中包括所有绿叶蔬菜、西兰花、绿茶、牛油果和豆制品，并说：“我想我们只能把这些都戒了。”患者出院前的最后一次生命体征：体温 98.6 °F (37.0 °C)，心率 72 次/分，血压 130/76 mmHg，呼吸 14 次/分，SpO₂ 98%。无新的瘀伤。左腿水肿无变化。抗凝诊所的预约确认在出院后两天，患者有一张打印的预约卡。护士复习了需要紧急救护与当天联系抗凝诊所的体征和症状。

stem.en: After reviewing the INR result with the patient and his wife at Stage 1, which of the following is the most appropriate response by the nurse regarding the enoxaparin bridge?
stem.zh: 在阶段 1 与患者及其妻子回顾 INR 结果后，关于依诺肝素桥接治疗，护士最恰当的回答是下列哪一项？

stem.en: Based on the medication reconciliation list and the patient's statements at Stage 1, what is the nurse's priority action regarding the patient's ibuprofen use?
stem.zh: 根据阶段 1 的药物核对清单和患者的陈述，关于患者使用布洛芬，护士的首要行动是什么？

stem.en: During the return demonstration at Stage 2, the nurse observes the wife preparing to aspirate before injecting the enoxaparin. What is the appropriate nursing action?
stem.zh: 在阶段 2 的回示教过程中，护士观察到妻子在注射依诺肝素前准备回抽。护士应采取的恰当行动是什么？

stem.en: At Stage 3, the patient asks about returning to work as a long-haul truck driver in four days. What is the most appropriate response by the nurse?
stem.zh: 在阶段 3，患者询问关于四天后重返长途卡车司机工作岗位的事情。护士最恰当的回应是什么？

options.en: Suggest that the patient discuss this with his employer, as return-to-work clearance is an administrative matter.
options.zh: 建议患者与他的雇主讨论此事，因为重返工作岗位的许可是行政事务。

options.en: Inform the patient that he can return to work as long as he stops every two hours to stretch his legs.
options.zh: 告知患者他可以重返工作，只要他每两小时停下来伸展一下腿即可。

options.en: Advise the patient not to return to driving until cleared by the provider, and document this occupational concern for follow-up.
options.zh: 建议患者在获得医生许可前不要恢复驾驶，并记录这一职业安全顾虑以便随访。

options.en: Tell the patient that driving is safe since he will be on dual anticoagulation to prevent any further clots.
options.zh: 告诉患者驾驶是安全的，因为他将接受双重抗凝治疗以防止产生更多血栓。

correct.en: The patient is on dual anticoagulation with a subtherapeutic INR. Long-haul truck driving involves prolonged immobility (a DVT risk factor), limited access to emergency care, and potential impairment from bleeding events. This poses a significant safety risk that requires provider evaluation before clearance.
correct.zh: 患者正接受双重抗凝治疗，且 INR 低于治疗水平。长途卡车驾驶涉及长时间不动（DVT的危险因素）、难以获得急救医疗服务以及出血事件可能造成的损害。这构成了重大的安全风险，需要医生在批准前进行评估。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. While stretching prevents DVT, the patient is actively being titrated on anticoagulants for an acute DVT. Driving a commercial vehicle is unsafe until medically cleared.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。虽然伸展可以预防 DVT，但患者目前正因急性 DVT 而在调整抗凝剂剂量。在获得医疗许可之前驾驶商用车辆是不安全的。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. The dual therapy increases bleeding risk in the event of an accident or emergency, and his INR is not yet stable.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。在发生事故或紧急情况时，双重治疗会增加出血风险，而且他的 INR 尚未稳定。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Return-to-work following an acute cardiovascular event with high-risk medication initiation is a clinical safety issue, not just administrative.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。在发生急性心血管事件并开始使用高危药物后重返工作岗位是一个临床安全问题，而不仅仅是行政问题。

byChoice.en: Correct. Identifying occupational immobility and bleeding risk as a discharge safety concern is within the nursing scope of advocacy and care coordination.
byChoice.zh: 正确。将职业性制动和出血风险识别为出院安全顾虑属于护士的倡导和护理协调范畴。

testTakingStrategy.en: Recognize that 'prolonged immobility' is a primary risk factor for DVT. Discharging an acute DVT patient back into a high-risk environment without medical clearance is unsafe.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 认识到“长时间不动”是 DVT 的主要危险因素。在没有医疗许可的情况下让急性 DVT 患者出院回到高风险环境是不安全的。

stem.en: At Stage 3, how should the nurse address the dietary plans regarding vitamin K and green vegetables?
stem.zh: 在阶段 3，护士应如何处理关于维生素 K 和绿色蔬菜的饮食计划？

options.en: Advise the patient to only eat green vegetables on the days his INR falls below the target range.
options.zh: 建议患者只在 INR 降至目标范围以下的那些天吃绿色蔬菜。

options.en: Encourage the daily consumption of spinach and kale to prevent anemia associated with blood thinners.
options.zh: 鼓励每天食用菠菜和羽衣甘蓝，以预防与血液稀释剂相关的贫血。

options.en: Clarify that the goal is to maintain a consistent daily intake of vitamin K, rather than completely avoiding or abruptly increasing these foods.
options.zh: 澄清目标是保持每天摄入一致的维生素 K，而不是完全避免或突然增加这些食物。

options.en: Agree with the wife's plan to eliminate all leafy greens to prevent the warfarin from becoming ineffective.
options.zh: 同意妻子停止食用所有绿叶蔬菜的计划，以防止华法林失效。

correct.en: Warfarin inhibits vitamin K–dependent clotting factors. Abrupt elimination causes INR to rise unpredictably (bleeding risk), while large increases in intake decrease INR (clot risk). Consistency is the evidence-based guidance. Furthermore, warfarin does not cause anemia through nutrient depletion.
correct.zh: 华法林抑制依赖维生素K的凝血因子。突然消除会导致 INR 不可预测地上升（出血风险），而大量增加摄入会降低 INR（血栓风险）。保持一致性是基于证据的指导方针。此外，华法林不会通过消耗营养素而导致贫血。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Eliminating vitamin K foods creates INR instability, nutritional deficiency, and is a common dietary misconception.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。消除含维生素 K 的食物会造成 INR 不稳定、营养缺乏，并且是常见的饮食误区。

byChoice.en: Correct. Consistency allows the warfarin dose to be safely calibrated to the patient's usual diet.
byChoice.zh: 正确。保持一致可以安全地根据患者的日常饮食来调整华法林剂量。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Patients should not self-manage their INR through erratic dietary changes. Diet should remain consistent.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。患者不应通过不稳定地改变饮食来管理自己的 INR。饮食应保持一致。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. A large dietary increase antagonizes warfarin, lowering the INR and potentially allowing clot extension. Warfarin does not cause nutritional anemia.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。饮食中大量增加（维生素K）会拮抗华法林，降低 INR，可能导致血栓蔓延。华法林不会引起营养性贫血。

testTakingStrategy.en: For warfarin dietary questions, 'consistency' is almost always the correct answer over 'avoidance' or 'increase'.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 对于华法林饮食的问题，“一致”几乎总是正确答案，而不是“避免”或“增加”。

stem.en: The nurse educates the patient at Stage 2 on recognizing bleeding signs. Categorize each sign based on whether the patient should seek immediate emergency care (call 911) or contact the anticoagulation clinic the same day.
stem.zh: 护士在阶段 2 对患者进行了识别出血体征的教育。请根据患者应寻求紧急医疗救护（拨打911）还是当天联系抗凝诊所对每个体征进行分类。

rows.zh: 突然剧烈头痛伴意识模糊
与外伤不成比例的新发瘀伤

rows.en: A small nosebleed that stops after 10 minutes of firm pressure but recurs later the same day
rows.zh: 施加重压10分钟后停止，但在同一天晚些时候复发的小量鼻出血

correct.en: Patients on dual anticoagulation must categorize bleeding by urgency. Sudden headache/confusion suggests intracranial hemorrhage (emergent). Coffee-ground emesis indicates active gastrointestinal bleeding (emergent). New excessive bruising and recurrent superficial bleeding that responds to pressure require prompt evaluation and possible dosage adjustment but are generally managed via the clinic unless bleeding is massive or uncontrolled.
correct.zh: 接受双重抗凝治疗的患者必须按紧急程度对出血体征进行分类。突然头痛/意识模糊提示颅内出血（紧急）。呕吐咖啡渣样物表明活动性胃肠道出血（紧急）。新的明显瘀伤以及经按压可止住但复发的浅表出血，需要及时评估并可能调整剂量；除非出血量大或无法控制，通常可通过诊所处理。

byChoice.en: Intracranial bleeding is a life-threatening emergency requiring 911.
byChoice.zh: 颅内出血是危及生命的紧急情况，需要拨打911。

byChoice.en: Active upper GI bleeding can lead to rapid hemodynamic instability and requires immediate emergency care.
byChoice.zh: 活动性上消化道出血可导致血流动力学迅速不稳定，需要立即进行紧急救护。

byChoice.en: Bruising requires evaluation for supratherapeutic INR but is not a 911 emergency unless rapidly expanding or compromising circulation.
byChoice.zh: 瘀伤需要评估是否有超治疗水平的 INR，但除非迅速扩大或损害循环，否则不是 911 紧急情况。

byChoice.en: A recurring nosebleed that responds to pressure requires medical attention same-day to manage hemostasis and check INR, but calling the clinic is the appropriate first step. Bleeding that will not stop with pressure is an emergency.
byChoice.zh: 对按压有反应的复发性鼻出血需要当天就医以控制出血并检查 INR，但第一步应该是联系诊所。按压后仍无法停止的出血属于紧急情况。

testTakingStrategy.en: Differentiate between signs of internal organ bleeding (brain, GI tract), which are life-threatening emergencies, and superficial bleeding (skin, mucosa), which require prompt clinic follow-up.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 区分内脏出血（大脑、胃肠道）的体征（这是危及生命的紧急情况）和浅表出血（皮肤、粘膜）（需要及时到诊所随访）。

stem.en: Read the case study and answer the questions that follow.
stem.zh: 阅读案例研究并回答以下问题。
